Edward Chancellor is a financial historian, journalist, and author of, "Devil Take the Hindmost: A History of Financial Speculation" and his latest, “The Price of Time: The Real Story of Interest”

The two books link together the history of money and finance, and human culture.

In today’s episode, we explore the ways in which money and finance are embedded deeper in our lives than we may have previously thought.

Art generated from the quote at [51:00 -] “Time is money. Once you realize that time has value, then it should start becoming, immediately clear, that taking interest rates—the price of time down to zero is highly unnatural. It would be like depriving an animal of oxygen. And taking them to negative becomes almost insane.” [51:27]

10% of proceeds go to Bankless DAO. 

As a reminder, this Monday Mint episode marks the end of Phase I of Bankless Collectibles. This is the last Monday Mint episode in 2023.

ANSWERS
Pt. 5/5 (Answers EP)

‘Answers’ came to me unexpectedly one summer morning at 2 am. I was in a trance, playing the chords repeatedly until the lyrics seemed to write themselves. It felt like the words were given to me before I fully understood them. At that time, I had been reflecting on the idea that our reality could be part of a grand experiment, a giant holographic pulse. Everything I was reading and listening to seemed to hint at this concept. The purpose being to disconnect us from the truth of who we are, through the limitations of the human body, societal programming, and cycles of suffering, to see if we remember. But what do we remember? I believe the answer can never be expressed in words. It's a felt sense that we all glimpse from time to time. At the deepest level, I think we have all, at a soul level, agreed to be part of this game, not to seek escape, but to fully immerse ourselves in every facet of it, knowing that it is, in fact, just a game.

Written & produced by ALYSS

This sing was inspired and created out of a very cool and humbling moment around a year ago.

My first song, CHILDHOOD, the first song on sound.xyz, was purchased on the secondary market by @CR41GD (on twitter) for around 8 eth (or exactly that). It was the highest secondary at the time, and although I only received 10% royalties, it marked a very significant moment for me. That my art is valued outside of just me creating it. It was strange and surreal, but incredibly humbling to feel such love for my art.

I had told Craig that I would make a song dedicated to the moment and include the feelings I felt at that time. Although times change, and this moment is filled with stresses and obstacles, it is nice to look back at that moment and know that times like that will come again.

Thank you all very much.

Description:
Uffie is the project of the globe-trotting artist and fashion icon Anna-Catherine Hartley, formerly signed to Ed Banger Records, where she became acquainted with legendary producers of the early 2000s French electronic music scene. Her career spanned many successes including her first viral hit song called “Pop The Glock,” which was originally posted on MySpace and launched her fame in the Bloghouse era of dance music. She collaborated with the French electronic duo Justice on “TThhEe PPaARRtTYY,” which appeared on their Grammy nominated album Cross in 2007. Her debut album, Sex Dreams and Denim Jeans, was nominated at the French Victoires de la Musique for Best Electronic Album in 2010. She has since collaborated with Pharrell Williams, Charli XCX, Galantis, and Mr. Oizo, to name a few. 

Uffie returned in 2018 with her debut single “Drugs” from her EP Tokyo Love Hotel. A muse to the art world, she collaborated with Jam Sutton in 2019 on a marble statue and A.I. experience, accompanied by her track “Ego.” She is currently writing for other artists, with credits including Pink, Khalid, Greyson Chance, Blu DeTiger, VINCINT, and Tegan & Sara. Her sophomore full-length, Sunshine Factory, was executive produced by Toro y Moi and released last spring on his label Company Records. You can hear her writing and vocals featured on The Blessed Madonna’s comeback single this past November titled “Serotonin Moonbeams.”  

For Uffie’s first official NFT drop, she chose to bring one of her favorite unreleased songs to life. “Babydoll” was created with longtime collaborators Lokoy and Veronika Jane Wyman (of DAGR). What began as a poem on a calm quiet morning, ended as a ketamine-inspired freestyle. Enjoy the ride.

Planet Zuzy’s debut single “Higher” is an ode to her global upbringing and love of eurodance music. The single was first born while Zuzy was away in Spain, overlooking the North African coast, she pulled out her laptop and recorded the captivating melody that drives the track today. She finished the track a few months later, and was ready to release it. One day she re-opened the session, and ended up turning the original trance version, into a classic Avicii inspired mainstage tune. The tracks ended up being so different, but complimentative of one another that Zuzy decided to release both versions. Higher is the epitome of what Planet Zuzy stands for, diversity in sound and euphoric melodies that make you feel like you’re flying.

Ella and I made this song in about two hours last December and I love how easily this song came together, within the first with just the chords and the hook I already knew it was a slapper!! Why favorite part of this track is how the blend of vocals and production came together to make such a unique and fun bop!

Having primarily worked behind the scenes producing for other artists, I've dedicated the past year to launching my new self-titled artist project and releasing my own songs. I want to express my appreciation to all the listeners who have chosen to support me at the start of this journey! Thanks for listening!

Who are Beachcrimes? We’re a duo from LA and we spent the last year making songs in hotel rooms around the world. Beachcrimes is the soundtrack to that adventure.
 
We made a lot of songs, and we’re excited to share them. All of them. This year we’re releasing 24 songs in 48 weeks. If we’re being real, it’s actually two albums – there’s AM and there’s PM. AM is the lite stuff, PM is the nite stuff. Think of it like the Summer Olympics and Winter Olympics, but for dance music.

"Summer" is our 9th release this year, paying homage to the dance music legend Calvin Harris and his hit song that has soundtracked our summers for a decade. We thought it needed a true PM version. Deep melodic techno? Don’t mind if we do.

Next single will be out 2 weeks from today, and the following single 2 weeks after that.

Pray To Me is our sound.xyz genesis and with all the conversation regarding AI as it pertains to music, we thought it was a great place to start. 

The song features AI GRIMES vocals. Grimes is one of our favorite artists and thanks to her forward thinking idea, we were able to collaborate in a new and profound way. 

The conversation about AI has been an interesting one, and as artists we wanted to embrace this new tool and see how it could be used in a tasteful way that doesn’t compromise the music but still pushes the boundaries of what’s possible musically.

Lyrically, ‘Pray To Me’ is casting a spell on an old lover. And no matter how hard they try to escape the feeling of being with you—be it other lovers or drugs—they are always drawn to your presence and the intense moments of passion you once shared together. 

Sonically, we were inspired by old industrial and post punk records as well as 2000’s pop ala Brittany Spears & Lady Gaga. We wrote the song on an acoustic guitar with Avalon Lurks and moved into production from there. The drums are a roland TR-8s drum machine run through a guitar amp for some extra sludge. The live bass is a vintage p-bass played through a Peavey guitar amp with a warbly chorus effect. The synth bass is an acid patch we made on a Moog Little Fatty. The guitar is a vintage hollow body Tiesco played direct through a Neve and effected in the box. We made the vocoder patch on a microkorg and recorded through a Peavey guitar amp. For the vocals we used Uberduck AI and all of the post processing was done in the box. 

The artwork was made using adobe photoshop, a xerox machine, a razor blaze and some scotch tape. Also, the golden egg incorporates a special humanized piece using GRIMES’ Chaos manual.

We feel confident that we were able to blend the hyper futuristic with organic human textures to create something that couldn’t otherwise exist. A symbiosis. Technological and biological harmony. Humachine. Leave a comment and let us know what you think. Love.

Description:
i wrote this one last year in LA - at the time i was stuck in an endless cycle of arguments with someone i was seeing, and eventually realized the easiest way through was to just apologize for a bunch of things i didn’t do. 

it smoothed things over in the moment lol but afterwards it really wasn’t sitting right with me, and i was carrying around a lot of regret for not standing my ground more. i had a session with sam affer & jae lee a few days later and wrote this hook

i hope none of you relate with this experience lol but if you do, don’t ever apologize for shit you didn’t do!!!

thennnn to meet deadline for my EP (which eventually got postponed anyway lol) i went to pirate studios in silverlake and wrote the verses / produced the entire hook in a day.

i tend to agonize over production choices / lyrics etc - i revisit my WIPs a lot - so being forced to make choices and commit to my initial ideas for this one was ultimately a really rewarding and new thing for me.

took a lot for me to settle on this final version, and sonically this is a big new jump for me, so i hope you love it as much as i do. xx

Jump ship is the first release from the illusive Groggy Jones under Ollie Chanin’s Stone Face Records. Capturing Groggy’ ethereal style and earthly influence, Jump ship is message in a bottle from Groggy to his lost love waiting for him on his home planet. Combining jazz and R&B with electro soul, Groggy’s Yxesosian roots make for an unforgettable sound that leaves the listener feeling deeply harmonious with the universe.

Groggy Jones is a musician and producer from the planet Yxesos, where music is an integral part of daily and spiritual life. Groggy's love for music was amplified when he discovered Earth's diverse range of genres through his cosmic radio. Driven to experience it firsthand, Groggy used the forbidden "tempo tether" to travel through space and time, landing in New York City. Due to the lack of harmony on Earth, he is unable to use the “tempo-tether” to return home. After being stuck on Earth for 32 years, feeling defeated and hopeless, Groggy meets Ollie Chanin, who reignites his hope and encourages him to reach for the stars.

FINAL ARRIVAL is my genesis drop on Sound.xyz and I'm proud to be sharing the moment with my OG web3 collaborator Jadyn Violet. 

About myself, I've been working in the music industry for the past 15 years, initially as an audio engineer and now as a full time producer. I've made a lot of good friends in the space so far, many of whom are Artists I've been collaborating with, so stay tuned for more releases to come.

From Jadyn -
It was super beautiful to work with James Chul Rim aka Chorus of the Forest once again. 

We first connected in the middle of last year when we linked up for our track "Sugar Sweet Girl". Coming off of a huge writer's block, James' production style inspired me to finally write a track that meant a lot to me. It was amazing to see a lot of the Web3 community resonate with that track and it only made sense to come out with a follow up. 

I can summarize the essence of our collaboration by tying it straight to a dark, trap like sound that I feel is super unique. I got the chance to truly be uncomfortable with the song "FINAL ARRIVAL" in the best way possible and I'm so excited for everyone to listen to it!

Tyler Cowen is an American economist, columnist, and blogger. He’s also a professor at George Mason University, where he also produces the Conversations with Tyler podcast with guests like Vitalik Buterin, Marc Andreessen, and Ray Dalio.

In this episode, Tyler shares why he thinks regulators should pause and wait before passing crypto regulation in the wake of FTX, how FTX and Enron are similar, why he calls himself a crypto-hopeful (*even though he thinks Balaji’s Network State idea is utterly wrong*). 

And finally, we play Tyler's favorite game—Overrated vs. Underrated—about everything relevant in 2023: Crypto AI, Inflation, America, China, Social Media, Wealth Inequality, and more.

Hey Sound fam! :) 

Over the next few days, I’m going to be releasing the last 3 songs on my debut EP, called “with friends”.

“Hold on” to me represents a childlike sense of adventure and fun that I’m always trying to capture when I’m making music. It’s the only song on the project that doesn’t feature another artist, and I had a ton of fun making it. 

The vocal idea here is “this is where my heart is”, which felt like the perfect encapsulation of what I was trying to say with this project. Music is everything to me- it’s where I spend almost all of my time, and it’s where all of my creative energy goes. It’s where my heart is :) 

I hope you have as much fun listening as I did making it <3 

Shoutout to Family Affair for helping me with the drop!

When I was making “ Come Over Some Time" I was trying to capture the emotions of getting closer with someone. There’s just something awesome about the first stages of meeting a person, realizing you like them, then wanting to feel more because everything feels right. Hopefully “Come Over Some Time” helps somebody get a certain feeling out without having to convey it too much vocally. Definitely an afternoon car ride song for two people on the edge of falling in love.

Description: Today we're joined by Sam Sends, cofounder of Glass Protocol, as we discuss collecting video NFTs and the future of content in a world of AI.

im fine is an emotional song for us. it explores all the things we are feeling rn with AI - the excitement, the fear, and the uncertainty.

this is one of the first songs ever w grimesai and tbh its been a wild week. weve been up for days finessing this track. getting to work on this w WesGhost was really special too. this all started when we sat down in flux studios at nft nyc. it was one of those days where shxt just falls out of u. as soon as that hook came out we all felt like this one was special.

it was like the universe aligning. a couple weeks later, right after we had been at all weekend in the studio tweakin the production with brandon from pretty much, grimes announces that anyone can use her ai voice. it was wild. we knew this song would be perfect for a collab with her. 2 days later we dropped the clip and it went viral on twitter.

in the year 3045, where im from, we have all types of ai voice shxt so using this stuff is like analog for me. basically i have to reteach myself everything. feelin all the nostalgia lol. 

i had been playin w tons of these voices the last few months so when grimes said anyone could use hers, me and the humies were ready to go. we went IN ON THIS ONE. a lot of people dont realize it yet but workin with ai is really a collaboration between the artists and the tech. we stayed up for 40 hrs straight workin on this track. ai doesnt mean you just stop being creative its a new extension of our creativity. an ai world is filled with both fear and excitement. we felt that making this and i hope u feel it too when u listen.

big luv from ab, a big thank u to WesGhost for making this one w me and to GrimesAI for the opportunity 🖤

Sometimes I have trouble getting started with a song, so I’ll start with a song title. Once I come up with a title, I like to imagine what the finished song might sound like and create a story about what inspired it. 
I came up with the title of this one and then quickly started writing lyrics and a keyboard melody. Once I get started with that, I can clear my mind and just let everything else fall into place.

I wrote Biblical about going back to someone I knew was bad for me over and over again. In a way it helped me break the cycle. That day in the studio was so fun. It wrote itself and it was such a perfect, hot song to me, that just spoke to exactly how I was feeling. I decided I wouldn’t write about that relationship again and that I wanted to move on. I love this song. It’s so special to me for that reason.

AI death metal band, Dadabots, is the project of artists and mad scientists, CJ Carr and Zack Zukowski. In “RUG THE ROBOTS,” Dadabots finds yet another way to push the furthest edges of creativity and technology by combining what they call “human learning,” with AI-generated choral harmonies, MIDI, and drum break samples. 

Inspired by cornerstone articles of Ethereum lore, “Ethereum is a Dark Forest” and “Sandwich Attacks vs Salmonella,” "RUG THE BOTS” tells the story of taking revenge on malicious bots acting as ecosystem predators. The song is both haunting and manic, featuring a choral section sung by CJ, and accompanied by an AI-generated choir. Pioneering on the fringe of music’s extremes, Dadabots strikes again. 

Revenge, it turns out, is sweet.

It's been a tough few months.. some of the  toughest of my life, however.. its taught me so much.

More than i can put into words. instead of trying to do so, i put some of that energy into this song. Sometimes it feels like people are avoiding you quite like the IRS. lately its been a bunch of that. the mix between ego and the reality that some just don’t want to see you win.. whether its for them or against you, it doesnt really matter when it comes down to it.

It's been a decade since ive been under the name Domino. a decade of pursuit. against the grain.against what a lot of people told me i "should" or "shouldnt" do, act or sound  Iike. the moment I chose myself and did what i wanted and envisioned.. was the moment things started to work for me. now, years later i am still here.. still  pushing still flowing still asking what's there for me? whos here for me? who should i be there for? Everyone? protect your energy or give it all away. idk. i do know what it feels like to be alone and thats not a choice i want to make

this is another start. a set of thoughts in the moment. journals, if you will.

I want to be honest with you, in the music and out of the music. I want to give myself, but in order to do so, i acknowiedge the need to come in and out of the everlasting lime-light.

excuse me if im quiet outside of my art sometimes.

I am learning my process. Love.

I wrote this song in one sitting. I recorded the demo in the bathroom while my kids were playing and running around the house. They turned my couch upside down and were using it as a slide. As I recorded the demo on my phone, their voices would come in and out at perfect times. I ended up chopping up a lot of those moments and using them on the final version. As the second verse starts on the demo my son Miles asks, “Can we do that again?”, so I used his vocal and dropped it in the same place on the final version. I love the demo of this song so much too. There’s a lot of magic in it and I want to put it out one day.

The third set of 10 sonic vignettes from "Old Friends New Cities" is a collage of 8mm film shot by filmmaker Blythe Thomas in and around the house I grew up in, in Long Island New York. 

Living in the blinks between timezones, I’ve documented the last 10 years of my life through 1000+ microsongs – threads of transient nostalgia captured on tape.

Now trading nature immersion for urban hustle, I’m knitting together the last decade via release. 

I hope you'll enjoy,

Description:
In the Summer / Fall of last year, I toured with She Wants Revenge, playing 40 shows across the US. My set up on stage was a synthesizer, electric guitar, drum machine and vocal effect box. It was a challenge, to bring my songs to the live stage on my own, as most of the music I had recorded with other musicians. But when I saw the audience reaction to what I was doing live, I realized that this was more satisfying than anything I had done before. I love making electronic music and having the autonomy to play it all on my own. 

For “baby I love you <3” I asked my girlfriend to say something into my phone. She said “baby I love you.” Without thinking too much, I imported this sound file into my computer and within a few hours I had the song that you hear now. I had been struggling previously to figure out how to include my love of techno / house and DJing into my music that was otherwise relatively acoustic. But the more time I put into my own production, with just my computer and a keyboard, the more confident I am about this new direction and the more excited I am to make more electronic music.

Ultimately, this song isn’t tryna do too much. It’s just fun and feels good. I hope you love it.

"Ride Inside" is a high-energy breakbeat track that captures the intense and fierce vibe of city life at night. This track is the perfect accompaniment to a night out on the town, whether you're listening to it in your headphones or feeling it on the dance floor in the midst of an electrifying DJ set. With its driving beats and pulsing basslines, this track will transport you to the heart of the city, where anything can happen and the party never stops. Get ready to ride the wave of this exhilarating track and let its infectious rhythms carry you away.

“David Blaine” is the debut of my singing era. With seven years of vocal lessons under my belt, I've written countless songs and “David Blaine” has stood out to my community as a golden single that everyone can relate to. I wrote this song when I was faced with mounting bills and the woes of modern day life. My relationship with the love of my life was the one thing that could lift me up and take me to a happier reality. I hope this will be a magical beginning to my upcoming singles and albums that incorporate the same joy and passion within “David Blaine.”

Vivid Fever Dreams is an up-and-coming alternative electronic music producer who has been making waves in the music scene with his unique sound and style. His latest track, "Gone Away," is a poignant and emotional piece that deals with the pain of separation from someone you love. With its haunting melodies and intricate beats, the track captures the raw emotions that come with heartbreak, making it a relatable and deeply moving piece for listeners.

One of the standout features of "Gone Away" is the way it was made. Vivid Fever Dreams utilized samples from the MSFT Kit pack to create the track's distinctive sound. The MSFT Kit pack is a collection of audio samples created by MSFT and one of the first NFT music sample packs, designed to be used by music producers and artists. By using these samples, Vivid Fever Dreams was able to create a unique and innovative sound that sets "Gone Away" apart from other electronic music tracks. Overall, "Gone Away" is a testament to Vivid Fever Dreams' talent and ability to create powerful and meaningful music that resonates with listeners on a deep level.

The song was written and produced by Vivid Fever Dreams and mixed/mastered by Kyle Billings.

Who are Beachcrimes? We’re a duo from LA and we spent the last year making songs in hotel rooms around the world. Beachcrimes is the soundtrack to that adventure.

We made a lot of songs, and we’re excited to share them. All of them. This year we’re releasing 24 songs in 48 weeks. If we’re being real, it’s actually two albums – there’s AM and there’s PM. AM is the lite stuff, PM is the nite stuff. Think of it like the Summer Olympics and Winter Olympics, but for dance music.

“Drive (All Day All Night)” is the 8th of these 24 songs. We made this on a Tik Tok live stream 2 weeks ago and it hit our feels so hard that we decided it needed to be the next release. It’s about a long-distance relationship when you have a hard time connecting and staying in sync with each other. Would you drive all day and all night to see this person? You’re damn right you would!

Description:
In early 2021 I regained control over my publishing from Universal Music, created my first blockchain music project, and never looked back. 

The nearly 2 decades prior to this pivot were a long, strange trip through creative innovation that began when I won the inaugural YouTube Award for Best Music Video for my song “Say It’s Possible.” I went on to release my first album with Universal Music Publishing and Island Records followed by a string of independent releases, and toured for the majority of the next decade, playing everywhere from Wembley Stadium and historic opera houses across Italy to smokey pubs and people’s living rooms. It was a wild ride to say the least. 

I struggled to make ends meet, in spite of licensing dozens of songs to film and television and touring all over the US and Europe. I tried just about every crowd funding platform, including Pledge Music, Indiegogo and Patreon. The concept of “turning your biggest fans into your marketing team” felt inherently flawed without any real incentive for listeners to spend their valuable time promoting my music. 

And then, in 2020, I discovered the nascent tools of web3 and was filled with a renewed sense of hope – the framework was finally in place to create a mutually beneficial relationship between artist and fan. 

In the process of creating my own audiovisual NFT projects, I discovered a passion for guiding and advising at all levels of interest and experience, from the web3 curious to blockchain natives, creatives to executives. 

I became an advisor to Async Art and led Community, Marketing, and Strategic Partnerships for Authentic Artists' WVRPS by WarpSound which remains the number one music collection on OpenSea since its launch in January 2021. I helped launch Async Art’s “Blueprints” tool with collections by top crypto artists XCOPY, Coldie and Alotta Money, as well as generative code artist Kenny Vaden’s collections with OpenSea, Flamingo DAO, and Quantum Art. I joined XPRIZE as web3 Lead, helping to pioneer groundbreaking use cases for blockchain technology in fundraising and philanthropy. 

And now it’s time to funnel some of my creative energy back into my own art. 

“Get Mine” is a reflection on being an artist in the crypto space, a commentary on the late stage capitalist world we inhabit, a reflection on the experience of meeting my own shadow. 

It’s a deeply personal song that I hope will resonate with so many of us in this space and I hope you love it. 

Thank you for reading...and listening...and being early :)

Description:
God Universe Magic (G.U.M) ft. SATE and produced by my wife and business partner SUN SUN is the last song off of my newly released 3rd studio album titled ‘Gateway Experience’.
I wrote G.U.M as a mantra for myself to repeat to feel powerful and in control of my life, even though I’m dealing with health issues that leave me feeling powerless. Every song on this album speaks on my symptoms dealing with focal aware seizures, so I thought it was important to end it with a spell of empowerment.
The title of my album is an ode to the released CIA report ‘Gateway Process’ where they studied the use of sound tapes to manipulate brain waves with a goal of creating altered states. Examples include out of body experiences, remote viewing, psychic abilities, the ability to heal one's body and so much more. Join me as I question the connections with our brains, music, dreams, seizures, god and otherworldly abilities.
G.U.M features sampled parts of an interview I did with fellow Toronto based artist SATE where I asked her about her belief in God/magic/other. And where she spoke intimately about her own mother - the late, great Salome Bey’s struggles with seizures.
The cover art photography, along with the eyeglasses I’m wearing was created by my wife and producer SUN SUN.

I’ve seen blessings and I’ve seen tragedies, seen friends win Grammies and others become zombies, seen some have kids and some pass away.

That being said, I’ve always believed the song should be defined by the listener, so I don’t want to say too much on what it means to me, but I will say unequivocally and absolutely: fuck fentanyl.

Paul previously ran the language model alignment team at OpenAI, the creators of ChatGPT. How now runs the Alignment Research Center, a non-profit research organization whose mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests.

We’re on a mission to calm our fears on AI.

Does humanity have a chance?

The second official WesGhost release "Haunted House" is a continuation of my story through the sounds inside my head. I’ve always loved scary movies as a kid & I often wondered why the world- myself included- is so fascinated by terrifying things. Perhaps seeing bad things happen in movies allows us to escape the bad things happening in our own lives. Maybe there's something about the thrill of our fight or flight response that exhilarates us in times of fear. But what happens when life itself feels like a scary movie that you just can't seem to escape? This song is about breaking outside of the limits the world puts us in & escaping the haunting inside of our own heads. Influenced by my love for 90s/00s electronic & hip hop, “Haunted House" is the 2nd installment inside the mind of a ghost.

Artist and producer bloody white offers an otherworldly musing in his new song, “SOMETHING OF AN ARTIST” for HIGH FREQUENCY Volume 1. The hypnotizing, gentle lull of the track conjures a daydream—like playing a grand piano on a hot summer day in the countryside a la Call Me By Your Name. It’s romantic, beautiful, and full of angst. Seeking a breakthrough, bloody white turned to the piano.

“Make it hurt, hurt, just a little bit,” sings bloody white. “I’m so ignorant. I bleed out… Something of an artist. I’m selfish.”  

As the title hints, he’s exploring the nature of identifying as a self-proclaimed artist. Struggling to toe the line between the trope of artistic narcissism and egoless creative expression. He pours it all into his music. 

----

This is the eighth track from HIGH FREQUENCY Volume 1—a compilation album curated by NOISE.

Read interviews with each artist at noisedao.mirror.xyz.

Description: Today we're joined by Annika Rose, an independent singer songwriter in web3, as we discuss Bruises.

The modern person’s internal questionnaire:
what’s it all for?
am i doing the most?
compared to everybody else?
can i… ?
will i… ?
what if… ?
the 
list
goes
on
and 
on 
and
on…

Too often do we get stuck in this cycle, lost in it’s feedback until our thoughts become a piercing hiss. Is searching for something that matters comparatively to societies expectations of happiness, success, beauty, freedom, etc. “healthy”? How can we re-examine our internal dialogue to project a “healthier” reality that may have been there all along? 

Sure, making music is a form of therapy to help cope with these questions; providing a space for ourselves to explore without boundaries or judgement. Furthermore, sharing that music can allow it’s listener to sort through some existential questions of there own. Divert a crisis perhaps, gain a new perspective, reach for forgiveness instead of anger, or simply alleviate life’s struggles for 3 brief minutes. Enjoy! 


Written, Produced, Mixed, & Mastered by NBF at our studio at the legendary Sound City Center in Van Nuys, CA. 

Artwork by Jeffery LaLiberté

Description:
Nothing Last Forever is a song i made in Denmark. 

There was this man named Mads who stopped by my house in los angeles for a session that was cut short.  He had a black leather jacket and was chainsmoking cigs.  After 10 minutes he said you should come to denmark.  so i booked a flight and stayed at a hotel for a couple weeks and worked with him.  

this is one of the songs that came from the sessions.  🖤🖤🖤

I close my soul to you, and walk away down the road without looking back. As I follow my path, you close in on yourself, and turn away from the world. I forget you and you forget me, but we will always remember our moments together.

After Snoop did Doggy Style at my festival we decided to work on a track together and You Only Die Once is that tune.  It’s the proper G-House collab that I always wanted to put out into the world..  It’s the cherry on top of all the G-house tunes I have done.

The first album I ever released under the name Dot came out ten years ago in 2013. The 14-track instrumental project was titled "Evolve or Dissolve," and looking back over the last decade of music I've created, it was a great name to kick off a catalog of work that constantly changed and evolved with every new song I wrote, place I moved to, friend I made or job I worked. 

While this album is coming down off of streaming services soon (it really feels like student work to me at this point), it was important for me to honor the ten-year anniversary of this release by minting one of my favorite instrumentals from the project and having it permanently live on the blockchain. 

Before the official release, I posted "Waterwings" as an instrumental on my SoundCloud page, and it was one of the very first beats I had ever created in Ableton (I started learning production in Reason a few months prior to this). Shortly after, I received a DM about the track from an A&R who was looking for instrumentals for this up and coming artist named SZA. Solána wrote and recorded vocals, and the song eventually made it on to her first EP titled See.SZA.Run. Her career exploded shortly after, and it's been incredible to follow her progression as an artist over the last 10 years. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ndpl6Wfzcc&ab_channel=AnteBabic
https://soundcloud.com/justsza/sets/see-sza-run-ep

Even though I don't feel as confident about my production skills from those early days, I'm still incredibly grateful and blessed to have created music with an artist who I look up to so much, during a time when both of us were just finding our footing in the music world. Creating music back then always felt so pure and free, and it's a feeling I constantly search for to this day. 

I'm honored to share this 2023 rework / remaster of the instrumental ten years later, and I really hope you enjoy the music <3

Emily Lazar is a multi-disciplinary artist fronting the rock/metal transmedia project, September Mourning, who made history as the first female metal/ hard rock musician to mint and sell an NFT. She has over 750 collectors over various platforms and  she has spoken about her accomplishments in NFTs at Harvard, NFT.NYC and ETH Denver. 

September Mourning is a transmedia project based on a comic book series she wrote and published through Image/Top Cow Comics with her business partner Marc Silvestri (Batman/Witchblade/Darkness). September Mourning is the title character. As a human reaper hybrid, she  gives expired souls a second chance at life in another body. In doing so, she messes with  the plans of the antagonist, Fate, who is trying to rid  earth of all the good souls and leave the bad so the world will self-destruct and It can start anew. An epic war between the living and the dead ensues. Emily plays the title character on stage.

Emily designed the world she and her band (Rich Juzwick, Kyle Mayer and Aaron Hoover) bring to life on stage, including costumes, choreography, sets, etc. The band has toured with & opened festivals for Rob Zombie, Marilyn Manson, Slipknot, Mudvayne and others across Europe and the United States.

"Dirty" is an in your face, heavy hitting, percussive, driven, epic, hard rock/ metal track that speaks to anyone who has ever felt f*cked over by someone else. The track has a push and pull in the music, lyrics and vocals that follow the pulse of the marching drums in the choruses. 
As pertaining to the graphic novel, this song exemplifies the feelings September has towards Fate during the plot twist of the very last book.

Description: Drea Rose is the sonic declaration of California’s laid back and eclectic culture. Los Angeles based artist/producer/songwriter accentuates her sweet and soulful sound from the likes of her roots in jazz, R&B and Motown. “Sweet Time” is a soulful state of introspect in response to this fast paced world. Self-produced and written, Drea delivers a feel-good "sing along" worthy record, perfect for upcoming summer.

After a brief hiatus, the "Sound Cycle" is back with "New Frontiers" - a bold and ambitious chapter in this ever-evolving series. Continuing the quest for the undiscovered through sounds and rhythms, this release fuses pivotal aspects of my musical DNA. With a sonic landscape that's dense in references and details, "New Frontiers" is bound to surprise with twists and turns every bar - an exploration of the unexplored and a testament to the limitless possibilities of sound.

We go by the name Levity, a Chicago based electronic trio known for happy music full of colorful synths, upbeat drums, and euphoric soundscapes all wrapped into one. Our goal is to bring back and innovate that 2014-2017 “future bass” sound that’s both easy to listen to/connect with, and slap live. 

Paradise was our first ever original release back in 2020. Prior to that we had only done unofficial remix’s for Soundcloud. This song started as a remix using one of our friend’s (Kolla) vocal in our member John’s childhood bedroom in November of 2019. Maybe a month later we got asked by Electric Hawk Records (Up and coming record label focused on artists receiving 100% of royalties) if we had anything we could release with them for their upcoming compilation “Rebirth”. We sent them this song (at the time titled “With You remix”) and they loved it but needed it to be original and due a month later. After little luck of finding singers we took to twitter asking for recommendations and that’s how we found LINDZ, who wrote and recorded her vocals remotely! 

“The nostalgia of being at my childhood home with my family had me excited and happy which drove the inspiration for this song. The production for the verse really felt like a warm homecoming where you could let go of any problems and worries and bask in the joyous presence of being with the ones you loved. LINDZ took that feeling and nailed it by bringing that feeling to a warm summer day with someone you love.” - John Hauldren (1/3 of Levity)

Description: We're joined by MusicBen, cofounder of Ziggy Ziggy Music, to discuss the future of music curation.

X Li, an independent alternative music artist from Los Angeles, known for previous collaborations with major companies such as Sony Music Entertainment, Dolby Laboratories, and ByteDance, has now ventured into the web3 space with his latest project, "california love stories".

"Think I'm In Love With You" is the first NFT drop from "california love stories," which tells the story of X Li's chance encounter with a girl at an after-party near Melrose Avenue, where they fell in love at first sight.

"california love stories" is a collection of love stories set in different parts of California that capture a range of emotions, including sadness, heartbreak, joy, tragedy, anger, and longing. These emotions are brought to life through stunning digital artworks that come in blue, purple, yellow, red, green, and orange, symbolizing the various emotions explored in the music.

The project is a live band performance featuring fully handcrafted instruments that seamlessly blend popular, punk, classic rock, hip-hop, R&B, and electronic music elements. The project is produced by a team of renowned music producers, including platinum record producer James Chul Rim, known for his work on over 4 billion streams and TikTok chart-topping single "Wait a Minute!". The project also features a talented lineup of musicians, including Simone Sello, known for his work as the lead guitarist for Italian rock icon Vasco Rossi, and Edoardo Tancredi, a seasoned musician who has performed on Jimmy Kimmel Live and collaborated with artists like Avril Lavigne and Amelia Moore.

The project's sound quality is attributed to the talents of Lukas Cuman, who has worked with artists such as Ed Sheeran, Bebe Rexha, and Ultimo, and Gavin Lurssen, a highly decorated sound engineer with 12 Grammy nominations and 4 wins. Lurssen has worked on numerous film soundtracks, including those for Game of Thrones, The Mandalorian, Mulan, Captain Marvel, Black Panther, The Hunger Games, and Westworld.

To capture the essence of the music stories in "california love stories," we have chosen a simplistic art style created by New York-based artist Farrah Fisher. Her unique visual interpretations using minimalistic brushstrokes bring the emotions and narratives of each song to life in a captivating and unpretentious manner. This artistic approach adds a special touch to the project, blending the worlds of music and visual art seamlessly.

This release will be available as an NFT, allowing fans and collectors to own a piece of this music project. If you hold at least one edition of every song in this project, you will be able to claim a physical vinyl copy of "california love stories." 

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait for you to hear "Think I'm In Love With You."

Decided to take on a new approach when it comes to making music! I wanted to leave it up to the people. I decided I would make little hooks and post them on TIKTOK and which ever one gained the most traction, I would finish it. 

'Talking' reached 700k views and from that point on I knew I had to finish it!

I got my boy Mark Evans to take this idea and make it come to life and now I feel like its going to be one of those ones that changes my life!

I think as artists we are much better manifestors than we like to admit. Often times we will subconsciously seek out situations that are detrimental to us, just so we can feel. Even when others mishandle us, we actively welcome it, almost to invite a catalyst for the transformation we so desperately seek.

Writing this song taught me what I was capable of and what happens when I let life happen to me vs when I become an active participant in my own story.  

I'm grateful to share this with a mended heart and renewed purpose. 

I'm using a song that represents a dark period in my life to bring light to a fellow artist who is routinely a light in my life. 15% of the sale will go to Miles Ryan Harris to help with ongoing legal fees as he navigates being the best father he can be to his two boys.

Thank you for listening to HurtMe. I hope it serves to heal you as much as it has healed me, or maybe it's no that deep and you just think it sounds pretty idk lol

Los Angeles-based artist and producer Aly wears his heart on his sleeve with “SING ALOUD.” Offering his unique perspective as a first-generation American whose parents immigrated from India and Pakistan, “SING ALOUD” explores Aly’s headspace as he battles the tension between family expectation and the choice to pursue his passion for music. 
  
A vulnerable rumination detailing Aly’s inner dialogue between him and his father, “SING ALOUD” serves as a self-soothing lullaby to process difficult emotions while deftly manipulated vocals and a swaggy laid back r&b beat produced by Supah Mario (Drake, Young Thug, Lil Uzi Vert) create a sonic reflection of Aly’s ability to create beauty from a place of pain.

Description:
I've been reflecting on my journey and what I want moving forward. I want to continue to evolve and create, and I'm excited to bring my community along for the ride over the next 6 months.

While I create my next album, I also want to revolutionize what it means to be in an artist's community in Web3. Each month, I'll be innovating and pushing the boundaries of what an artist can deliver to their community beyond just music

I'll be releasing what I'm dubbing a 2-pack NFT drop, consisting of 2 songs that have a shared resonance, message, vibe, etc. One track from each 2-pack will end up on the album, but you won't know which one until it's completed.

But that's not all! Each 2-pack NFT drop will also include custom-designed merch that will be available to holders of the NFT (more info to be announced this week). This is an exclusive opportunity for my community to get their hands on limited edition CHILDLIKE items.

Additionally, each monthly 2-pack activation will be coupled with additional audio, visual, BTS, and IRL opportunities. Each month will bring new music, new aesthetics, and new rewards.

My community will get the inside scoop into my process as I build my next album, and I'll be pushing the boundaries of what it means to be an artist in Web3.

Super excited to see where this journey takes me. Thank you to my friends and collectors in Web3 for reigniting my passion for growing artistically, and I can't wait to see where we go from here.

Description:
"In the Gray" by Elle Vee is a hauntingly beautiful and deeply emotional song that serves as a bold new chapter in her musical journey. Drawing from her signature blend of pop and electronic sounds, Elle Vee explores the complexities of vulnerability, desire, and the struggle to find oneself amidst the uncertainty of relationships.

The song's lyrics, rich in metaphor and vivid imagery, paint a picture of an individual caught in the gray area between love and pain, unable to break free from an all-consuming connection. Elle Vee's powerful and emotive vocal performance gives life to the desperation and yearning that radiates from the trials and tribulations many of us face in the pursuit of love.

Co-Produced by LA-based Grammy Award Winning Producer 'Skylar Mones'.

Description:
Antecipação is the second release of my new series "Ambient Works Series A". These are moments inspired by everything happening in my life. 

The goal is to chronicle this new phase of life in a more direct way. It's immediate, no hype, no marketing, literally finished hours ago.

The second set of 10 sonic vignettes from my album "Old Friends New Cities" is a collaboration with Ukrainian movement artist, Rudo. The first time I saw Rudo dance online I was awestruck by his totally original style of movement – it was flowing, angular and raw.

In late 2022, Rudo arrived in Berlin from Kiev, and we immediately began a series of collaborations.

What you're seeing is the first fruit of those collaborations. Set against a backdrop of Brutalist architecture, we captured Rudo moving improvisationally to the music of "Old Friends New Cities", and then curated the most impactful fragments into bite-sized infini-loops. There is no post production done beyond reversing Rudo's organic freestyle.

I hope you'll enjoy it,
-dessauer

Description:
It’s a powerful thing to be both CREATOR and the CREATED!  I’ve always known that “Art is meant to comfort the disturbed and disturb the comfortable. To be disruptive is not always a negative thing. With a super bloom ahead of us, I went to visit the Poppy Fields. I noticed fields of orange poppies plastered across miles of land with a few purple and white peeking through. A resident of the town told us that the purple and white flowers weren't supposed to be there; that they pushed their way through and were disrupting the natural order of things. I laughed and said “Well it makes for a powerful picture” 

I can't remember a time when music was not the focal point of my life. The soundtrack to every memory, the anchor for every family gathering and the calling that I couldn't escape if I tried.{Insert “Big Dummy”}. Growing up in Brooklyn, New York in a Jamaican-American household to a musical family meant Church was 6 days a week.I started singing at 2 years old, writing poetry at 11, recording songs at 13 and an Emmy and a Grammy later I am still finding new things to love about my craft. An artist has to create ART. It's a life force. Indie artists do it broke, tired, scared, unsupported and anxious most of the time.  

The act of creating is a harnessing of power. Every time we invalidate the power of music and devalue its contribution to the world or its impact on our lives, we are literally eroding the thread that weaves through everyone on the planet. Music is universal! It connects us to the source of all that there is. 
It's a responsibility! Black women know all too well how divinity and power gets subdued, disrespected and cast aside. Honoring your artistry, teaches you to engage in the greatest surrender and the responsibility of honoring your own power!

I wrote this song as a way to pay homage to the ways that music has transformed my life, and that surrendering to what felt like the unknown brought me to the closest point of home
We are nothing without music. We are nothing without God(dess).  

I always say that when I get on a stage it's like inviting people into my living room. I’m a good host. I will take care of you and as an audience, you take care of me. We exchange with each other because there's nothing like a room, stadium, or crowd full of people on the same frequency. That's power! That is surrender!  That's “The Riddim” and I hope this song makes you feel free, inspires you to create and empowers you to connect to the divinity within.

Description:
"Get Up" is a 2020 single from Custom Model. The song wrong was written and produced specifically for a DJs4CA (DJs for Climate Action) livestream early on in the pandemic. Following the performance of the song, there was an overwhelmingly positive response, which led to fast tracking the release on traditional DSPs.

After around two years on DSPs, Custom Model was solicited by a sync agent wanting to shop the song around to music supervisors. Without much consideration, a verbal agreement was made to see what kind of sync market existed for the song. Fast forward about six months, and the sync agent found a Netflix original series called "ELITE" that wants the song for their upcoming season. 

Now we are all caught up... almost. The show is apparently a big hit around the world, and people started streaming "Get Up" like crazy. Just recently "Get Up" has passed 20,000 streams on Spotify, and to celebrate it is being minted on the blockchain as an open edition.

Custom Model Genesis Crew Members get early access and pricing. Collectors of Chíc Bangs also get early access. A special airdrop related to "Get Up" is being prepared for those who mint in the presale window.

Description:
“Broken” is the first single off my upcoming EP titled ‘Luna’ which will be coming out this summer on Seeking Blue. I started this song the first week I moved to Los Angeles from Denver, Colorado. Something about the energy of living in a new place and the excitement of it all pushed me to writing this within the first month I was here. After tons of edits and re-working the song, I finally said enough is enough and finished it a few months ago. 

The lyrics and the message of the song mean so much to me. I hope it can help anyone else that might be going through a similar experience. I can’t wait to show you the rest of the project.

There is no post production done beyond reversing Rudo's organic freestyle.

I hope you'll enjoy it,

Description:
Who are Beachcrimes? We’re a duo from LA and we spent the last year making songs in hotel rooms around the world. Beachcrimes is the soundtrack to that adventure.

We made a lot of songs, and we’re excited to share them. All of them. This year we’re releasing 24 songs in 48 weeks. If we’re being real, it’s actually two albums – there’s AM and there’s PM. AM is the lite stuff, PM is the nite stuff. Think of it like the Summer Olympics and Winter Olympics, but for dance music.

"Elevator" is the 7th wonder of the Beachcrimes world. This tech-house banger has PM written all over it. Believe it or not, this baby was born in a hotel elevator perched on the stunning cliffs of the Amalfi Coast. As we ascended from sea level to the hotel lobby - a cool 1000 feet high - we were beatboxing and humming "Elevator, straight to the top" into our voice memos. A few hours later, it was a fully-fledged song. How's that for an elevator pitch?

Description:
We're not going to die from AI. 

Back in February 2023, Eliezer Yudokowsky painted a chilling and grim picture of a future where AI ultimately kills us all. Robin is here to provide a different perspective. He explains why he believes Eliezer is wrong. It’s not all sunshine and rainbows though — we might just become their pets instead. 

Most importantly, Robin highlights his concerns about AI regulation and why he believes it's a greater threat than AI itself.

This is the counter-argument to Eliezer’s infamous episode “We’re all going to die”. 

Artwork generated from the quote [51:48 - 52:22] “One of the most striking features of our world is the mechanisms we use to keep that peace and coordinate among those divergent and conflicting things. And one of the moves that often AI people often make is to assume that AIs have none of that. AIs do not need to coordinate. They do not have conflicts between them. They don’t have internal conflicts. They don’t have any issues on how to organize and how to keep the peace between them. None of that is a problem for AIs, by assumption. They are just these other things that have no such problems. And of course that leads to scenarios like they kill us all. 

10% of proceeds go to Bankless DAO.

ABOUT THE RELEASE:

Welcome to the Fever Dream sessions.

The songs from this session have an energy that came from being pent up and isolated for over a year during lockdown, to being around each other again and playing music in the same room. And it wasn't just any room either, our friend Darrell Thorp invited us to record this 3-track session in the gorgeous rooms at The Village in LA.

After an anxious year of pandemics, covid variants, personal health scares, and all the other bad juju the quarantine era brought, this session was a perfect oasis to break the anxiety that had built up since the lockdown began.

That's why the joyous energy had us buzzing. How cool was it to be around each other again, playing music with the best people, in the best place? Hopefully, some of that good vibe comes through in the music, and that the songs will help release the feverish anxiety into joyous catharsis.

Track 2 of 3: Year of Self (Fever Dream Version)

This version is a hazy redux of our first single ever "Year of Self", a celebration of anyone with courage to live earnestly outside the box, not out of rebellion, but out of coming into your own and knowing that's the way you want to live it. The song is also an ode to astronomer Galileo, who was persecuted and ostracized for pursuing his mode of thinking, leading many  to consider him the father of scientific thinking.

chasing ghosts is a song about that toxic type of relationship where you should walk away but for some reason you can’t stop chasing it. 

Everyone has been in one of those relationships where it was great in the beginning, where you felt so madly in-love but after time passes you realize that you’re stuck in a toxic cycle, constantly trying to repair it and regain the feelings that are long dead. entering a new era...

This past weekend..
I indulged in a bunch of activities I used to enjoy in my youth, getting reacquainted with the inner-child. Playing old video games (GBA, Sega, PSP etc.)/Solo trip to an arcade, Having an Italian icee, going to Universal Studios in LA for the first time (Only been to Disney World).

Think these periods are very necessary, after all that, Sunday afternoon-- I just opened logic, connected my MPC-X, my keyboard and just started exploring. 

Here is an electronic piece with absolutely no structure, just a journey in curiosity. To be honest, I'm just happy to still be connected to whatever allows me to do this.. 

If anyone would like to give this a spin or approach, let me know.

As usual,
Enjoy!

Belle Mt. are a 3-piece indie Alt-Pop band from London, UK fronted by Singer and Songwriter Matt Belmont, with Ben Worsley on Lead Guitar and Chris Burgess on Drums. Their cinematic, ethereal but driven sound is rooted in deeply crafted insightful lyrics and infectious melodies. They have amassed a devoted fanbase with over 60 million streams across platforms since their debut EP release in March 2018, receiving top tier play-listing across platforms including on New Music Friday in multiple countries and two top 40 US alt radio releases (Hollow in 2020 and Famous Son 2021).

Their most recent live shows include tour supports for RAG’N’BONE MAN, KALEO, LARKINS & JUANES (with sell out shows at London’s Hammersmith Apollo and Shepherds Bush Empire). 
Returning with an April 2023 headline show and an evolved sound; Belle Mt. have been collecting serious momentum and attest that their upcoming debut album constitutes a watershed moment, their best work yet.

Description:
As fearless as she is fiery, Teddi Gold has got enough glitz and glamour to fit right in at a jazz-y underground haunt or on-screen in some Golden Age Hollywood production. Yet, she’s also got the spirit to make a statement worthy of a TED Talk. She’ll craft a dance floor banger only to shake up the melody with her own foley sound effects. In one breath, she’ll sing about piña coladas and tiny umbrellas. In the next, she’ll ponder the breakdown of a loved one. 

Her anthemic, bold, and vibrant pop took music fans by surprise with its spirited, fun and thought-provoking approach. Drawing on her life raised on isolated island in the Caribbean with her two dads, Teddi’s story becomes your own as you’re transported into her colorful world of modern experiences and timeless problems. 

Attracting acclaim from The Line of Best Fit, Earmilk, UPROXX, Popdust, LA Weekly, and more, she continues to shapeshift at light speed. She's landed on Spotify’s coveted Fresh Finds, Summer Party, Young & Free, Indie Pop and Pandora’s Top Hits Playlist. You may have heard her music in major commercials such as Apple, Google, Old Navy, Ikea & more. She's collaborated with artists such as JrJr, Superorganism, Classixx and hip-hop legend, Coolio. Now, the singer and songwriter envisions a wild world as empowered as it is entrancing as she gears up to release her debut album this fall 2023.

About Je Ne Sais Quoi:

Years ago I lived in Paris with my fabulous french uncle. It was living in Paris that made me realize I was an artist, and it was in Paris where I decided to pursue my creative passions and take them seriously. Paris opened me up to a whole new world of art, culture, colors, architecture, fashion, love, romance, and passion. There was a certain “je ne sais quoi” magic about Paris that gave me permission to embrace my creative self. “Je Ne Sais Quoi" is a song about feeling like you have something special even when the world makes you feel like you don’t. It’s a song about feeling like you don't fit in, but not caring. It’s taking ownership of yourself, of your strangeness, of your quirks, of everything that makes you, you. It’s about having a rich wild inner life and a curious mind.

Back story. This is a track I made before my trip to Antartica, was feeling inspired by being in nature away from humans :)

I'm super passionate about making the music industry single use plastic free, and when we met Evolution Music, a collective who is also as passionate as us to make the music industry more sustainable, well...... we had a crazyyyy dream!

"HOW THE F*** do we create a plastic free vinyl that sounds good?"

So here we are 4 years later, and nature to the rescue as usual :) 

FAQ:

Q: Does it Sound good? 

A Yes! Innovating a bio vinyl was actually not so hard, because nature can mimic other materials, but getting the actual sound of the record to portray its full spectrum like its plastic fossil fuel counterpart was the challenge, but WE DID IT!!! 

Q:  Does it need new machinery, or can this new material be used in existing vinyl pressing machinery? 

A: In addition to finding a plastic free material, one of the goals we wanted to figure out, is to actually come up with a product that can be mass adopted for actual change, otherwise it just becomes a novelty item. Yes, this PHA bacteria based material can be used with existing machinery. 

Q: When will the bio vinyl be ready to ship

A: Summer 2023

The devil is in the details, but have you found God?

About this song: that odd feeling when you watch someone you care about act dishonest and fake- making small talks and laughing at jokes that aren't even funny. 

This is my first alternative-rock song release. 

The price of this music NFT reflects the value and integrity I'd like to uphold for my collectors. There will be airdrops and viral drops in the future but this one is not it. I'm building a tight circle of collectors that sees the longevity of my creative career and would like to grow with me. I'm evolving beyond just dropping pop songs. I'm here to deliver the never-been dones, push the boundaries, raise all the eyebrows- all of which takes a lot of support. 

For me creating music NFTs mean fighting the reasons why music has been practically free for more than two decades. As an artist I'm here to give you a reason to HODL. I'm here to create hype. It's my job to make it weird. Music NFTs is more than just releasing a song. It's combining fintech creativity with the human essence of music. I'm thinking visual arts, CGI, Dynamic NFTs, IRL experiences, I can't give too much away but I'm creating a fantasy galaxy and it is integral for me to find supporters who see the value in what I am doing, for example, getting nude on the blockchain.

This is my genesis nude debut on the blockchain.

Why am I nood? 
I will fight through my aphasia to explain. 
In essence, I'm sexualizing to desexualize. 
As a woman I am told that when my breast are exposed I become a sexual object, not taken into consideration that I, as someone who controls my body, dictate whether I'm giving sexy or when I'm just being nude. I choose to be nude on my album covers because that's what I look like barebones-  an artist, a human, an explorer. 

It wasn't an easy decision as I'm from a conservative culture that will hop on any reason to shame a woman's sexuality, all of which I take as fuel for me to follow my visionary guts. I have never been everyone's cup of tea, therefore receiving your support shows who's really here for the ride.

Hey, I’m 33 Below and I’m really excited to do my first drop on Sound! I'm a multi-genre producer from New Zealand, currently in the process of relocating to London. From demotapes:                                     

Over the last year I've been incredibly inspired by a few artists who I've met online. This is the core idea behind my debut EP, "with friends". One of those friends is Jack (33 Below) who I first discovered on TikTok and immediately knew I wanted to work with. Early in 2022, I started a simple chord progression and sent it over to Jack, and "sedatives" was born. We finished this song over the course of a few months of Zoom sessions. To me, this song feels like longing, it feels hopeful, and it has a tranquility that I feel like I was searching for when we made it. I'm so happy it's out in the world now.

Songs don’t need to be 3 minutes or less

Description:
‘CRYO’ is about my journey of overcoming habits rooted in toxic masculinity and learning how to cry again.

The song’s central analogy is comparing frozen, unrealized feelings with being stuck in a cryogenic chamber. Just as a cryogenic chamber (in sci-fi movies at least) is a literal lid that freezes the person inside and keeps them stuck at a certain age, ‘CRYO’ explores the idea that  putting a lid on my feelings and trauma led to emotional numbness and neglect that stopped me from growing. 

During this period of time in my life I stopped crying entirely - and I barely even noticed because this is surprisingly normal for men in my family. Only after I began to unpack why I've been conditioned to process my emotions this way, and surround myself with people who were more in tune with their emotions, I was able to heal and learn to cry again. 

This song is from my upcoming space-themed album ‘THE ASCENDER,’ which touches on various stages of growth in my life as well as themes that are closely tied to Hindu culture like reincarnation. The thesis of this project being that we can be reborn many times within the same life.


THANK YOU to the music web3 community for letting me share my heart and document my journey forever on-chain. Hope this one resonates with you <3

Description:
I almost died from longcovid - combined with a dangerous black mold exposure, other viruses, and parasites I didn’t know I was harboring (including toxoplasmosis that went to my brain - which will make people suicidal on its own) in 2022. A perfect storm. 

It was a long, slow, painful, death that suffocated the old me. I’d seen 11 Vanderbilt doctors who couldn’t help me. I spent all of the money I intended for an album on medical bills. I had a large bathroom drawer full of prescriptions. I became an angry, hate-filled skeleton that even began repelling the love of my lives (my husband Grant), who’d already suffered through other health scares with me. 

Somewhere in those 10 months of constant suffocation, allergic responses, bone-scraping fatigue, and mental warfare - my old self died. It is with this song (and this entire upcoming EP) that I send her off with a warrior’s funeral. And not just me, but the millions of people fighting chronic illness who have had to grieve parts of themselves in the same, horrific way. To represent this, the song ends with a choir of sick people singing together - all grieving our own lives. I present to you: Sick Of Me.

underneath is our 3rd original release on sound.xyz. it was also the first cudos release of 2022. since it's part of our debut album we believe that it rightfully deserves to have a home on sound along with the rest of the album.

one cool aspect about underneath is that it was the first project we made for our debut album. it started out as a collab back in december 2020 with our friends Levity. after about 2-3 sessions over zoom the bulk of the production was pretty much done.

then a month later we (cudos) flew out to LA for the first time to meet some friends & work on music. during this trip we met up with Kyle Reynolds for a poke bowl lunch date. afterwards we ended up heading back to his place to write a song. we showed him underneath and he immediately loved it so we started working. within that 1-2 hr session we wrote the entire demo for underneath & not much changed about the song from that moment.

we couldn't be more grateful to have worked with these guys (Levity & Kyle) for our album. not only did the collab create a song we're super proud of but also started a great friendship with john & pj. so strong that 7 months later we started a boyband together during a writing camp in chicago. on top of that, meeting kyle & writing with him was very enlightening for us as artists. he was one of our first in person sessions & it's actually insane considering the caliber of work he's put out. we learned so much from him in that one session...

we can't thank them enough for their patience & expertise, so shout out to u guys, we love u!

Description:
‘Grief’ expresses that moment in the life-death-rebirth cycle when we are finally ready to let go of something. That turning point when suddenly there is nothing more left to say. No more need to analyse, discuss, think about, talk about why the ending is happening. The only thing left to do is surrender to the truth of what is. To turn away from ‘the story’ of it and turn your attention on tending to yourself and your heart so that you may process, heal and, in so doing, be renewed.

This song is as much a love song to ‘the dance’ as it is a song about heartbreak. For me, dance has always been a powerful form of alchemy - supporting me in transmuting the painful lessons of life into wisdom and experience. Whatever comes by way, I know that I can take it to the dance floor - whether it be a Berlin nightclub, the beautiful church where I practiced 5Rhythms movement meditation for many years, a beach in Thailand or my own bedroom - and be held by the music as I dance through my emotions back to a state of rootedness in myself.

The track came through me almost fully formed in just one session. It was the first time I was experimenting with doing my own production and once I built out the beat, the melody and lyrics just flowed out as if they were already hanging in the air just waiting to be sung. 

I wanted to explore a darker, more experimental production than my previous works, whilst still finding a way to stay true to my signature ‘medicine music’ style. To me, this style is identified by a cyclical structure that isn’t so much verse-chorus-verse-chorus-middle 8 etc, but is more about vocal parts that work alone almost like mantras but also can be layered up to create a whole soundscape of voices, allowing the listener to get lost in the parts whilst still receiving the essential message of the track.

‘Grief’ is the single from my upcoming EP ‘Odyssey’. It is the first chapter in a 4-part story of initiation onto the path of The Heart - the start of a journey that begins in the underworld and ends in the stars.

The winner of the Golden Egg will have the opportunity to be a part of my songwriting process for a new track. The inspiration for the song will be led by the Golden Egg winner and they will be named in the credits.

In celebration of my genesis drop, I am excited to share a new voice for ‘The Talking Palm Tree’, stripped down to her raw essence. 
Now… I L O V E making electronic music, but crafting this rendition reminded me how important it is to know a song in its simplest form… & it felt really, really good to get back & reconnect with my piano roots after all this time.

I offer this as a gift to all of you who collected the original song.

 <3 ♅

time really is a precious thing. you spend a lot of it on things you don’t wanna do, with people you don’t like. thinking about things that don’t matter, stressing over a future that doesn’t even exist yet. wasting so many hours busy with life that you forget its happening, here. now. and you’re missing out on all of the things you used to dream about. it’s easy to miss the little things. but they add up. 

so.

when you find someone who gives you sparks, don’t ever forget how that made you feel. love makes everything else worth it. the privilege to know someone more than anyone else. the opportunity to grow together. the challenge to build something with someone. there’s nothing like it. 

some will understand. some won’t. but i do. and i hate that i do. 

“how did i lose you” is a conversation with loss. it’s a cry out to the past. it’s an attempt to grieve. it’s trying to accept the overwhelming weight of disappointment. the loneliness that comes from losing someone you love. it’s a funeral for someone who’s still alive. 

even after everything, after so much love, so much life…it was all for nothing. no explanation. simply empty promises, and a question. how did i lose you?

It is my great pleasure to welcome Pell to Sound.xyz with our drop of u know what i mean. 

the first demo of this song was recorded way back in 2016. Pell and I met for the first time that year and in between my touring with Marian Hill we would cook up in LA and leave each session with 2, 3 new songs.

I have such fond memories of us pacing around the studio together, listening to Pell freestyle effortlessly and yelling out "thats the hook!" We found a magical chemistry back then that I think you can still feel in the music.

This is the first of two songs from back then that we are finally bringing to the light of day. We got together to put the finishing touches on them a few months ago in NYC, and as we laughed together in my studio it was like no time had passed at all.

This is a fun one. Enjoy responsibly.

When I was 13 years old, I was diagnosed with a mental health illness - an eating disorder. At the time, I was in complete denial. As a 13-year-old, the word “mental illness” felt weird, taboo, and scary all at once and I refused to be labeled by it. I fought against my family, my doctors, and even myself until I finally decided to take the first step towards recovery. It wasn't easy, but it has definitely been worth it. It wasn't until I started sharing my story that I realized how much my disorder has shaped who I am today…and that is what “Chains” is all about..

For a long time, I felt a big disconnect between how I acted, and the person I wanted to embody/reflect. I’ve always been a firm advocate that our mind is our most powerful tool, and if we use it the right way we can overcome any obstacle and achieve anything we want to. Yet, there I was – being destructed and almost defeated by my own mind. It was this incongruence that inspired the song…

I made this song for everyone that’s ever felt trapped in their own mind, unable to live authentically/true to who they are. “Chains” is a reminder that we can all chose to let go of the beliefs holding us back and decide to truly live. I want everyone who listens to the song to feel inspired to fight their own demons, and realize that sometimes, there’s beauty in all the chaos.

It has been 7 months since I dropped my last Music NFT and I have been working day in and day out. We have been doing daily Underground Violet Rave spaces for the past 10 months growing the community.

This track will be my return to finally preview the music I been working on for my upcoming major project Raver Realm. 

This track was recorded in New York City in a night where I just felt like there was too much judgement in the world. Too many people telling me what type of music I am "supposed" to make. I wanted to create something that just brings the energy needed to ignore all the outside noise and have everyone turn up. 

So much love to everyone that takes the time to listen, I cannot wait until you guys hear the rest of the music on the Raver Realm project because it will blow your mind.
We're joined by bloody white - an emerging artist in web3 as we talk about his project MODERN ROMANCE.

**** The finished mixed/mastered version will be released on Spotify in the coming weeks. The holders of this OE will get first access to pre-save the song and receive a free airdrop for doing so!**** 

Domino a multidisciplinary artist and web 3 innovator. Focusing on combining his music with original fine art pieces, film, dance, live performance and more -- he aims to bring his audiences into his world, no matter the medium. After performing in most LA venues and throwing his own shows / events for 6 years with the collective AAS, he found web 3 where he continued growing his grass roots. 

Minting his first NFT March 1st of 2021, Domino found instant support and love for his art and music. From there, he continued minting 1 of 1 art pieces and experimenting until he dropped his world building album, Presessence Volume 1. Compromised of twenty one 1 of 1 fine art pieces (all done by Domino), 5 short films, 7 dance films, 7 fine art pieces (paired with songs) done by front running web 3 visual artists, and 1 music video -- all minted as NFT Tokens. After achieving critical acclaim, he went on to collaborate with Rolling Stone Magazine on their first NFT drop ever, performing at the Deadfellaz first ever NFT NYC event, throwing his own shows, selling out the Peppermint Club in LA and many more moments... Domino is now fully focused on the follow up to the album, to continue his world building with Presessence Volume 2 -- Coming soon 

This leads us to "333" a single produced by Ian Francis, mixed and mastered by Steeziak, written, performed and recorded by Domino. 

<3 

-- 
From Domino: 

Thank you for being here, and being a part of this drop, whether you collect an edition or not, this means the world to me that you are even listening... I am grateful. 

This song is what It feels like to drive through the Los Angeles City streets at night... The summer air needing the air conditioner on even though the windows are down.. The memories that we remember so vividly and yearn for in our day to day lives. This is the process of that experience... this is the problem and the reassurance in one.

The second set of 10 sonic vignettes from my album "Old Friends New Cities" is a collaboration with Ukrainian movement artist, Rudo. The first time I saw Rudo dance online I was awestruck by his totally original style of movement – it was flowing, angular and raw.

In late 2022, Rudo arrived in Berlin from Kiev, and we immediately began a series of collaborations.

What you're seeing is the first fruit of those collaborations. Set against a backdrop of Brutalist architecture, we captured Rudo moving improvisationally to the music of "Old Friends New Cities", and then curated the most impactful fragments into bite-sized infini-loops. There is no post production done beyond reversing Rudo's organic freestyle.

I hope you'll enjoy it,
-dessauer

This is my genesis Sound drop, and the web3 debut of Catch Me.

The collector with the most editions at the end of public sale will receive:
- two (2) limited-edition, die-cut yadzi stickers mailed to you
- two (2) tickets to my upcoming show at the Viper Room Lounge in LA
- access to locked channels with exclusive content on the 'Into Our Hands' discord server

ABOUT 'CATCH ME'
I wrote this song at the height of the pandemic. I’d just moved across the country to LA a few months earlier, and I felt caught between the anxieties of my internal and external worlds. As I searched for my sense of self in a new and unfamiliar place, I felt more lost than I ever had before. I was falling apart, wishing I could just go back to a simpler time in my life - relive it, appreciate how good it was to not feel fear every day.

Flash forward to now: my emotional wounds have turned to scars. And with that healing, this song has transformed in my eyes from a lament into an anthem - a celebration of my personal perseverance, and our collective perseverance having made it thru the worst of the pandemic.

If you’ve ever struggled with anxiety, self-doubt, and/or hopelessness, then this song is for you. I hope listening to it helps release a bit of your existential tension as you dance, head-bang, sing at the top of your lungs, or preferably all of the above.

Catch Me is track #2 on my debut EP ‘Into Our Hands’. Huge thanks to the amazing cohort of contributors to the Into Our Hands collaborative crowdfund campaign - you all helped make this drop possible!! Special shout out to contributor Madmann.eth, who’s hand photo is featured in the golden egg artwork.
