I wanted to create a version that someone can dance to and embrace the pain of a breakup or loss — even celebrate it to a certain degree. Description:
In a quaint coastal town, where the gentle lull of ocean waves was a daily companion, lived a young woman named Maya. Her heart beat in rhythm with the sea, and her dreams were woven with the colors of the ocean. Maya had always possessed a unique gift – an innate ability to sense the stories that the waves carried within them.

Maya's passion lay in music, particularly the kind that captured the ebb and flow of emotions like the tides. She spent her days composing melodies that mirrored the whispers of the sea, and her nights experimenting with electronic beats that resonated with the tranquility of the waters.

One evening, as the sun dipped below the horizon, casting hues of orange and pink across the sky, Maya felt an overwhelming urge to translate the ocean's tales into music. With her keyboard and synthesizers, she embarked on a creative journey that would birth a track like no other – "Aquatic."

The first notes of "Aquatic" mirrored the gentle lapping of waves against the shore. As the melody progressed, it evolved into a rhythmic dance of crescendos and decrescendos, just like the tides' eternal dance with the moon. Maya's fingers moved across the keys with a fluidity that could only be born from a deep connection with her muse.

As the music spread its wings, something extraordinary happened. The townspeople, drawn by the captivating sound, gathered along the beach. With their feet sinking into the soft sand, they surrendered to the enchantment of "Aquatic." The music seemed to open a door to a hidden underwater realm, where they could glimpse the secrets of the sea.

With closed eyes, they saw vibrant coral reefs swaying to the rhythm, schools of fish creating intricate choreographies, and ancient sea turtles gliding with wisdom etched into their eyes. The music was no longer just an auditory experience; it had become a journey of the senses, a voyage into the heart of the ocean itself.

Maya, her fingers still dancing on the keys, felt an indescribable connection to the crowd and the sea. She was the conduit through which the ocean's voice found expression, merging with the beats and melodies that flowed from her fingertips.

As the final notes of "Aquatic" caressed the air, the townspeople slowly opened their eyes, returning from their ethereal underwater voyage. A sense of awe and gratitude lingered as they applauded Maya's musical gift. With tears in her eyes, Maya knew that "Aquatic" had transcended mere music – it had become a vessel for sharing the boundless beauty and wonder of the ocean with her community.

From that day on, "Aquatic" held a special place in the hearts of the townspeople. It played during moments of celebration and reflection, a reminder that the threads connecting humans and the natural world were as delicate and intricate as the melodies Maya had composed. Just like the ocean, "Aquatic" flowed through time, carrying with it the spirit of unity and the magic of a young woman who listened to the whispers of the sea.

Description:
Slink and Shimmer, Starry Night
2020 Vision - Hindsight Edition
Track 4

My first album, 2020 Vision was made in 2019 and originally released on Jan 1st 2020. It was a terrific experience, learning as I made, experimenting with all kinds of sounds and genres, but building with a full album experience in mind. The 12 tracks of the album rotate through the circle of fifths, with a track for each major key. It's a rather hopeful album I think, and it is interesting to look back on it, knowing just how much it contrasts with the year it entered. There is also a tinge of loneliness to some of the tracks, perhaps some of that underlying anxiety of seeing covid go down elsewhere in the world and wondering what could happen. This Hindsight Edition was an opportunity for me to go into the state of making these tracks, and feel out how my production has changed. One of the weaknesses of the original album was all the mastering was done with no prior experience, I literally had an ozone tutorial up as I did it. Nowadays I have a much better handle on those sorts of things and this Hindsight Edition is a way to get a new, clean modern master out there while still maintaining the original elements of the release. I hope everyone enjoys!

Berlin is a unique collage of beautiful and ugly elements. Comfortable and uncomfortable sounds. Totally bizarre and completely normal places. Soothing spaces and disgusting noises. I've always loved this city. Comfortable Noise is an expression of this fascination. 

The series consists of my psychedelic guitar loops and field recordings that I made during my stay in Berlin in 2021. These are not recordings containing the sound of specific places or situations. They are a record of the ordinary sounds of Berlin streets, which are the background to the soundscapes, and the song titles are my spontaneous associations with my time in Berlin in summer of 2022. The guitar parts were created using flashback delay, reverses and a little post-production in Ableton Live. 

Comfortable Noise project was published as a collection of singles on Spotify in 2022. In May 2023 I decided to collect them together and release them as a full LP. And now the series is my genesis drop on sound.xyz and it's my first music-only NFT project ever.

28 February 2022 at 3:00 pm… I’m smoking a joint with my old neighbour. We’re shooting the shit, and he shows me a Twitter post of some terrifying footage captured by an overseer in a distant apartment block during the invasion of Ukraine.

The footage shows a well-lit view of a Ukrainian highway. Taken from maybe a five-story high apartment building. There’s a fleeing civilian in a tiny white sedan hooking up the highway.. then, a sudden scream from one of the overseers… and a giant Russian tank mows the vehicle down like a blade of grass.. before they could even cross the border. The footage becomes shaken and fills with the sound of uncertainty and fear.

I myself was shaken by seeing this.. to even imagine how people may be affected there right now… I can’t fathom it. All I can do is make art and hope that it helps people in some way.

This tune came to fruition after seeing some terrifying footage of the events in Ukraine.

This is the last track on my album "Tuna"

It's featuring my other project, Oxis

This is what it feels like most of the time, and I didn't know how to articulate that with words

Produced and written by me 

Thank you for listening <3

Kirpi's was initiated by two songs: Human Food and Fareler!
Fareler! has been the band's most iconic and energetic song to date. (This may change with the second album...) 

Lyrics were written as a poem in 2004, when Jeff first moved to Manhattan, NY. An overpriced, tiny room with wooden floors, and a small window looking down to the garbage chute in a rat infested building was the inspiration for the lyrics. Music was written 8 years after that, by Jeffrey, during the break of another band's rehearsal: Jeff points his finger to Jeffrey out of nowhere, who was sitting right across him with his guitar on lap, and shouts: Write a song, now! Within a split second, Jeffrey starts playing the main riff of Fareler!. Song remained almost the same since its inception. True story...

Both the poem (2004), and the music (2012) are improvisational. They were written in one go, spontaneously.
 
Released in 2017, recorded in Istanbul - Turkey.

Kirpi will be releasing some tracks from their first album for FREE! We want our music to reach you and hope to find our global audience somewhere on the blockchain...

Here's a mega-thread about the band and the music: https://twitter.com/TrevesStudios/status/1681293167058997248

In a small mountain town, surrounded by majestic peaks and lush forests, two souls were destined to intertwine their destinies in an unexpected way. Branty, a frustrated musician with a past full of disappointments, and Millegan, a man passionate about the art of seduction and hopelessly in love with the romantic songs of Julio Iglesias.

Branty always dreamed of taking his music to the highest heights, but reality kept him anchored to his daily routine as a schoolteacher in the small town. After several failed attempts to launch his music career, Branty found himself disheartened and in search of inspiration.

On the other hand, Millegan, a charming and affable man, dedicated his time to enjoying life and conquering hearts. His weakness was the romantic music of Julio Iglesias, whom he admired deeply. However, behind his carefree facade, there was a loneliness that only music could fill.

The story takes an unexpected turn when Branty discovers an online platform called Sound.xyz, designed to connect musicians with listeners from around the world. Encouraged by the possibility of reaching new horizons, Branty decides to upload his compositions to the platform. Soon, his music begins to resonate with people from different corners of the planet, including the attention of Millegan.

Fascinated by Branty's ability to convey emotions through his music, Millegan contacts Branty to express his admiration. As the conversation progresses, Branty discovers Millegan's true passion for music and his unwavering love for the songs of Julio Iglesias.

As Branty and Millegan continue to interact on Sound.xyz, a deep connection emerges between them. Branty finds in Millegan a passionate listener who understands and appreciates his art, while Millegan discovers in Branty the company he had been searching for to alleviate his loneliness.

Throughout the story, Branty and Millegan explore together the mountains surrounding their town, sharing laughter, stories, and, of course, the melodies that have forged their special connection. Branty's music becomes the soundtrack to their friendship, a friendship that slowly evolves into something deeper.

Familiar Face In A High Speed Chase
2020 Vision - Hindsight Edition
Track 2

My first album, 2020 Vision was made in 2019 and originally released on Jan 1st 2020. It was a terrific experience, learning as I made, experimenting with all kinds of sounds and genres, but building with a full album experience in mind. The 12 tracks of the album rotate through the circle of fifths, with a track for each major key. It's a rather hopeful album I think, and it is interesting to look back on it, knowing just how much it contrasts with the year it entered. There is also a tinge of loneliness to some of the tracks, perhaps some of that underlying anxiety of seeing covid go down elsewhere in the world and wondering what could happen. This Hindsight Edition was an opportunity for me to go into the state of making these tracks, and feel out how my production has changed. One of the weaknesses of the original album was all the mastering was done with no prior experience, I literally had an ozone tutorial up as I did it. Nowadays I have a much better handle on those sorts of things and this Hindsight Edition is a way to get a new, clean modern master out there while still maintaining the original elements of the release. I hope everyone enjoys!

This track hits on a very particular feeling. I imagined a person who has made many decisions that made someone who lived "life on the edge". Poor decisions that hurt themselves and others. But perhaps there's is still something good and sentimental in that person, something that rarely floats to the top. The person has robbed a bank or something similar and is in hot pursuit. As their car races through the streets something happens. The person sees out their window someone from their past, a past that involves themselves as a very different person than they are in that moment. Maybe it is love, or a childhood friend, whatever it is, it's a person that only a better version of themselves could be with. Time slows in that moment, and all the greedy desires of the moment start to feel distant compared to this soft want of a connection. But the world does not stop, and their actions can not be denied for long, the chase must bring itself back to the forefront. All that is left following that is the nagging feeling of "what could have been."

About the album:
FUTURE SHOCK is an exploration of limits.
 In both music and endurance sports, I spend every day in search of a new physical or mental limit, but hoping I never find it. Creating music and experimenting with new technology is my way of expanding my inner world, and even though rapid change can be overwhelming at times, making this record helped me to reclaim control over my experience with technology: using digital tech, AI, and Web3 to find connection with the people around me instead of allowing them to cause separation.

Description:
We are a father and son duo 👨‍👦 ... 🥁🎺 from Estonia, and we are absolutely thrilled to share our debut album "24 Years Apart" on web3. Every track within the album tells a story, weaving together emotions that encompass moments of happiness, solitude, hope and aspirations. 

✨ Today, we want to share with you the first track of the album. But that's not all! We've decided to make this musical journey even more exciting by sharing a new track from the album with you each week. Stay tuned for more music! 

The name "24 Years Apart" derives its profound meaning from the concept of being physically separated by the passage of years lived on this Earth, while simultaneously sharing an intimate and profound connection on a deeper level. It encapsulates the dichotomy of our individual journeys and experiences, as we navigate the vast expanse of time and distance.

We started working on the “24 Years Apart” album late in 2021 and it consists of 12 tracks. The idea of making the album was really intuitive, I just felt, that every idea produced in this period was connected with each other, and it felt quite evident for us to continue until there will be a feeling that this chapter is completed.

Decade's Last Dog Days
2020 Vision - Hindsight Edition
Track 1

My first album, 2020 Vision was made in 2019 and originally released on Jan 1st 2020. It was a terrific experience, learning as I made, experimenting with all kinds of sounds and genres, but building with a full album experience in mind. The 12 tracks of the album rotate through the circle of fifths, with a track for each major key. It's a rather hopeful album I think, and it is interesting to look back on it, knowing just how much it contrasts with the year it entered. There is also a tinge of loneliness to some of the tracks, perhaps some of that underlying anxiety of seeing covid go down elsewhere in the world and wondering what could happen. This Hindsight Edition was an opportunity for me to go into the state of making these tracks, and feel out how my production has changed. One of the weaknesses of the original album was all the mastering was done with no prior experience, I literally had an ozone tutorial up as I did it. Nowadays I have a much better handle on those sorts of things and this Hindsight Edition is a way to get a new, clean modern master out there while still maintaining the original elements of the release. I hope everyone enjoys!

This first track, Decade's Last Dog Days, was made in August of 2019 and combines a lot of the elements that individually play out in the other tracks. An indie electronic base, mostly positive, guitar, some classical flourishes and jazz instrumentation finding their way in, some bit-crushing and distortion effects as well. It's the C major track, and I think it is a good representative of those most basic of keys, and a great intro for the variety that the album entails.

JYG ( Just Your Girl) Masted Edition

This track, it's a special one. It carries the weight of a tale that's as heartbreaking as it is poignant. You see, it's about a friend of mine who found herself dancing to a complicated rhythm of love.

I made this song with a great friend of mine Os Young one night in his bedroom studio, it's a honest reflection of the artist life and being on the road. 

As soon as he hit record the first thing I free-styled was the opening line "shows, hoes, over exposed" and we both just looked at each other to acknowledge the banger we were about to make. If you enjoy listening to this one at least half as much as we enjoyed making it, thats a job well done.  

This platform and all of you that collect my sounds have allowed me to continue to create freely and support my community around me. The proceeds from this drop will go into the project I am working on so stay tuned for some cool things coming soon. 

Thank you for rocking with me! 

With gratitude always, 
Kai xx

Description: A remaster of my track "Novostroiki" which was released on my label Raw Union.

"Like Losers" explores the complexities of personal relationships and the impact of past traumas on our interactions. The song takes listeners on a journey through my own experience, where I felt mistreated in a relationship and later realized that it was a result of the other person's unresolved emotional struggles.

Sonically, "Like Losers" draws inspiration from early Twenty One Pilots and early Panic at the Disco, showcasing a compelling blend of alternative pop and bedroom pop influences. The track, which I produced entirely in my bedroom on my laptop, embodies the DIY spirit, raw emotion, and authenticity that I hold dear as an artist.

My aspiration is for "Like Losers" to reach those who have felt misunderstood, unappreciated, or mistreated in their relationships, allowing them to find solace and strength in the music, just as I did while creating it.

Description: Russian Dj & Producer ' Shahbass delivers a stunning debut release on Million Records with " My Love" a captivating deep and melodic house track.

"Gratitude and Joy at all Times will keep us aging like Fine Wine." - Hurric4n3Ike

Not sure how or when, but I know deep down in my soul this song will be played for generations during celebrations all over the world. Birthday parties, school dances, clubs, bars, pre-games, dance parties, discos etc etc. This song was inspired by the late night parties in Costa Rica where it seems like all the problems of life for everyone on the scene fade into deep night sky and all that exists is fun, dancing, smiling, beautiful weather, and love. I want this song to always bring whoever listens to it to that space instantly, an instant vacation. If you listen closely you can also hear the story of a young bachelor encountering a beautiful and inspiring woman on one of these ecstatic nights. Listen to the song for the full story haha. Anyways happy WavyWednesday fam, stay vibin' n Winin'.

Description: Hope, Joy, Electro!

As producers we spend our lives creating for other artists, but this project is an
opportunity to make something unabashedly 100% me - a tech-obsessed 90s kid, perpetually torn between analog nostalgia and unhinged digitalism.

Every choice is made with fetishized intention - I obsessively collect vintage PCs, Retro DIY projects (MiSTer FPGA, RetroWave OPL3 etc), and sound-chip
emulations, and they are all put to use here in hackish and creative ways.

Grunge guitars sampled into an Amiga 500, PC SoundBlaster synths decayed
through my 80s cassette deck, a Super Nintendo vocoded with dial-up internet
screeches, Napster-era low-bitrate MP3 breakbeats are all in the sauce. And of
course, Grimes AI on vocals.

Even the visuals are AI-generated, degraded to VHS, then digitally glitched by
injecting random data in a hex editor.

The lights "flipped on" for me at age 14, and my aim was to "overlap the 1996 and 2023 datasets" - providing a stark reminder that as AI permeates our lives, we become the analog synth. I choose to embrace this reality through rose-colored VR goggles.

The mesmerizing album encapsulates the pulsating energy of the city, painting a vivid audiophonic picture that immerses you in the bustling streets and neon-lit alleyways of Japan's tantalizing capital.

Francis Bacon Bits combines intricate beats, infectious grooves, and atmospheric textures; both hypnotic and invigorating. Their music is a fusion of diverse influences, seamlessly blending elements of funk, electronic music, and triphop with the sophisticated improvisation of nu-jazz.

Get ready to dive into the audio universe of Francis Bacon Bits and prepare to be transported to a world where infectious rhythms intermingle with ethereal melodies, where the boundaries of genres blur and transform. It's about accepting that it's healthier to let go instead of lying to yourself and your partner to make it work somehow but also about breaking free/moving on in life. It should make people feel warm and positive after all. While dealing with a serious topic, the song feels very light, upbeat and colorful.

Produced my the homie Dave Nunes from the Netherlands.

Ps: Rumor has it the guitar solo in the outro cures depression <3

Crafted by the ambient music artist, YellMore, the track was not just another addition to the artist's discography but an exploration of the correlation between serenity and sound. Inspired by the ethereal landscapes of Tuscany, the track was conceived during a solitary sojourn YellMore embarked on, seeking solace and inspiration in the serene, rural landscapes, under the starlit Tuscan nights filled with the symphony of crickets.

'NightShift' was more than a melodic composition - it was an auditory experience, a soothing escape into the tranquility of the Tuscan countryside. The track utilized the harmonious blend of ambient music and the therapeutic chirping of crickets to create a transcendent soundscape. The release resonated deeply with listeners worldwide, providing much-needed respite from the onslaught of modern life. The juxtaposition of the rhythmic cadence of crickets against the tranquil melodies was a philosophical statement by YellMore - a reminder of the inherent music in nature, often forgotten in our pursuit of artificial rhythms. Thus, 'NightShift' became more than a track - it was a meditative journey, a philosophical exploration, a testament to the restorative power of nature's symphony, and a testament to YellMore's musical escapade.

Description:
Producer Houis shows he isn’t just a lofi wonder, teaming up with experimental pop duo Couch Prints on whimsical new single "Say Enough". The NYC natives meld their unique styles to create a lofi, electronic creation fit for a breakup. 

The instrumentation was  definitely the most experimental song on the album. It has a pop-like arrangement, while using a 3/4 beat (inspired by some Bonobo songs I’ve been listening to lately). The FX, fluttering synths, and vocal chops were also inspired by Mount Kimble’s live rendition of “Before I Move Off” on KEXP (one of my favorite songs for the past decade).“Say Enough” walks the line between electronic and chillhop — Houis

At its core, "Say Enough" is a song about feeling empty. For us, some of the worst moments in life have not been about sadness, but about pure apathy" — Couch Prints

THE STORY SO FAR

Houis (pronounced “weece”) is a French-American producer based in NYC. Influenced by artists such as Bonobo and Tom Misch, his distinct R&B lofi sound has evolved to include elements of a newer indie/house aesthetic.

As both a visual and sound artist, Houis displays a dexterity between visual aesthetics and his music which alludes to a wide range of ever-evolving skill.

His debut album “Outgrown” perfectly depicts the full range of his musical convictions, from UKG inspired lo-fi instrumentals, 80’s leaning indie-pop Open & Repeat w. Emmett Kai , to soulful offerings with international guest features such as Daydreamin' w. Blush'ko.

"Nobody can doubt that things relapse. A man falls ill, and suddenly on a Wednesday, he relapses. A pencil on the table frequently relapses. Women, how they relapse. Theoretically, nothing or no one is supposed to relapse, but it's still bound to happen, especially because it relapses without consciousness, as if it had never happened before. A jasmine, to give a fragrant example. To that whiteness, where does its painful friendship with yellow come from? Mere existence is already a relapse: the jasmine, then. And we're not talking about words, those deplorable relapsing words, or cold pastries, which are the nailed relapse.

Against what happens, rehabilitation is patiently imposed. In the most relapsed, there is always something striving to rehabilitate itself, in the trampled mushroom, in the clock without a winding mechanism, in Pérez's poems, in Pérez. Every relapsing thing already has a rehabilitating aspect within it, but the problem, for those of us who ponder our lives, is confusing and almost infinite. A snail secretes, and a cloud inhales; surely they will relapse, but compensation beyond them rehabilitates them, makes them gradually climb to their best selves before the inevitable relapse. But we, aunt, how will we do it, how will we realize that we have relapsed if in the morning we feel so well, so coffee with milk, and we can't measure how far we have relapsed in sleep or in the shower? And if we suspect the relapsing nature of our state, how will we rehabilitate ourselves? Some relapse when reaching the summit of a mountain, when finishing their masterpiece, when shaving without a single nick; not every relapse goes from top to bottom because up and down don't mean much when you no longer know where you are. Probably Icarus believed he was touching the sky when he plunged into the Aegean Sea, and may God spare you from such an ill-prepared dive. Aunt, how will we rehabilitate ourselves?

Some have argued that rehabilitation is only possible by altering oneself, but they forgot that every relapse is a de-altering, a return to the mud of guilt. Indeed, we are the most we can be when we alter ourselves, we leave the mud in search of happiness and consciousness and clean feet. A relapsing person is then a de-alterer, from which it follows that no one rehabilitates without altering themselves. To seek rehabilitation by altering oneself is a sad redundancy: our condition is relapse and de-alteration, and it seems to me that a relapsing person should rehabilitate themselves in another way, which I otherwise ignore. Not only do I ignore that, but I have never known when my aunt or I relapse. So how do we rehabilitate, then, if perhaps we haven't relapsed yet, and rehabilitation finds us already rehabilitated? Aunt, could that be the answer, now that I think about it? Let's do something: you rehabilitate yourself, and I'll observe you. Several consecutive days, let's say continuous rehabilitation, you are constantly rehabilitating yourself, and I observe. Or the other way around, if you prefer, but I would like you to start because I'm modest and a good observer. That way, if I relapse during the intervals of my rehabilitation while you don't give relapse a chance and rehabilitate yourself as in a continuous movie, after a while, our difference will be enormous, you will be so far ahead, and then, I will know that the system has worked, and I will start rehabilitating myself furiously. I'll set the alarm for three in the morning, suspend my married life and the other relapses I know of, so only the ones I don't know remain, and maybe, little by little, one day we'll be together again, aunt, and it will be so beautiful to say, "Now we're going downtown and getting ice cream, mine all strawberry and yours with chocolate and a little biscuit."

Tribute to Julio Cortazar.

My release is a bold and unconventional combination of the world of Russian rap and cryptocurrencies. I decided to pay attention to the interconnection of these two industries, which seem so different at first glance. The goal was to create something completely new and fresh, to use slang and terminology from the world of cryptoinvestors, which makes the text more interesting and unique.

The story behind the creation of the release started when I watched many of my friends in the rap scene start to get interested in cryptocurrencies and investments. The idea for the release came to me after I spent a few weeks researching the topic of cryptocurrencies and blockchain. I thought it would be interesting to combine my observations and knowledge in one track. It was important for me to make sure that the lyrics were authentic and reflected the reality of the situation in the world of cryptocurrencies.

Behind the Music: "Walking (step)" featuring Godmother from Germany

In the summer of 2023, a powerful collaboration emerged from the unexpected meeting of two talented artists: Yankee beatz and Godmother, a rising star from Germany. The story behind the creation of their joint track, "Walking (step)," is one of serendipity, passion, and a shared love for music.

The Origins:

The journey began when Yankee beatz an ambitious and innovative musician, was exploring new sounds and styles for their upcoming music project. As they dove into the world of international music, they stumbled upon the mesmerizing tracks of Godmother. Captivated by her unique blend of soulful melodies and powerful vocals, Yankee beatz knew they had found the perfect artist to collaborate with.

The Connection:

Reaching out to Godmother,  Yankee beatz expressed their admiration and proposed the idea of working together on a song that could fuse their individual styles. To their delight, Godmother responded with genuine excitement and enthusiasm. They both believed that this collaboration had the potential to create something magical, something that transcended borders and resonated with a global audience.

The Creation Process:

The artists began their collaboration, despite being separated by thousands of miles. Through virtual meetings and late-night phone calls, they shared ideas, melodies, and lyrics. The creation process was a true blend of cultures and experiences, as they drew inspiration from their respective backgrounds.
The theme of the song, "Walking (step)," gradually took shape as they reflected on their personal journeys as musicians. It became an anthem for anyone who has ever taken that first courageous step towards their dreams, despite facing uncertainties and challenges.

Description:
Deep within the heart of Africa, in a vibrant village nestled between rolling hills and lush jungles, lived a young musician named Ayo. From a tender age, Ayo was mesmerized by the enchanting sounds that emanated from his surroundings – the rhythm of tribal drums, the melodious chirping of birds, and the gentle rustling of leaves in the wind.

Ayo's passion for music was evident to everyone in the village. He spent countless hours experimenting with various instruments, eager to create a unique sound that would celebrate the spirit of his homeland. One day, while wandering along the banks of the mighty river, inspiration struck him like a bolt of lightning. He heard a rhythmic pattern in the bubbling waters – a rhythm that seemed to resonate with his very soul.

Intrigued, Ayo hurried back to his makeshift studio, a small hut adorned with colorful tapestries. Guided by the memory of the river's melody, he poured his heart and soul into his work, creating a hypnotic electronic track that he named "Kuma Kuma" – an homage to the river's sacred song.

As word spread through the village about Ayo's creation, excitement and anticipation grew. The villagers eagerly gathered in a clearing one night to witness the debut of "Kuma Kuma." Underneath a star-studded sky, Ayo stood with his trusty electronic setup, his heart pounding with nervous excitement.

As the first notes of "Kuma Kuma" filled the air, an extraordinary transformation unfolded before the villagers' eyes. The once quiet clearing burst to life with vibrant colors, as if the very essence of Africa had come alive through Ayo's music. The beats seemed to echo the throbbing pulse of the land, while the melodies told stories of ancient wisdom and forgotten tales.

With each passing moment, the villagers surrendered to the enchantment of "Kuma Kuma." They swayed to the rhythm, their bodies moving as one with the music. In this shared experience, they felt a profound connection to their roots and to one another.

As dawn approached, the last echoes of "Kuma Kuma" faded, leaving the villagers in a state of euphoria. They embraced Ayo with gratitude and awe, acknowledging him as a true musical shaman who had harnessed the very soul of Africa in his creation.

From that day on, "Kuma Kuma" became an integral part of the village's cultural tapestry. It was played during harvest festivals, weddings, and gatherings – a reminder of the unity and joy that music could bring. Ayo's creation had not only celebrated his homeland but also left an enduring legacy that would resonate with generations to come.

And so, "Kuma Kuma" became more than just a song. It was a symbol of the beauty and power of African culture, a testament to the transformative magic of music, and a reminder that the most profound melodies are often found in the heart of nature itself.

In the heart of the bustling city, a mysterious club called "Electroverse" stood as a sanctuary for electronic music lovers. Among its resident DJs, there was one who went by the name "DJ Luna." Known for her enigmatic charm and captivating sets, Luna had a reputation for weaving immersive journeys through sound.

One fateful evening, the club's neon lights flickered, signaling the start of another unforgettable night. As the crowd gathered on the dance floor, DJ Luna took the stage. Tonight, she had a surprise for her devoted fans – a brand-new deep house track she had been working on tirelessly, titled "Blade Dancer."

The pulsating rhythm began to fill the room, and a mesmerizing melody enveloped the crowd like a warm embrace. "Blade Dancer" was no ordinary track; it seemed to possess a magical quality that pulled everyone into a trance-like state, as if the music itself was alive and dancing with their souls.

As the beat intensified, a vision emerged in the minds of the dancers. They found themselves transported to a mystical realm where they became graceful beings – Blade Dancers. Each movement they made echoed the ebb and flow of the music, as if they were wielding invisible blades with fluid precision.

DJ Luna herself felt a profound connection to the music. It was as if the melody guided her hands and fingers over the turntables like an ancient dance, syncing her with the energies of the crowd. She was no longer just a DJ; she was the conductor of this symphony of souls.

As the night progressed, the atmosphere inside "Electroverse" became electric, brimming with energy and unity. Strangers became friends as they danced together, a swirling sea of colors and emotions. "Blade Dancer" had forged a powerful bond between the club's denizens, transcending barriers and differences.

As the first rays of dawn touched the horizon, "Blade Dancer" began to fade, its ethereal notes lingering in the air like a bittersweet memory. The crowd slowly dispersed, carrying with them the magic of that unforgettable night.

From that moment on, "Blade Dancer" became DJ Luna's signature track, known for its ability to touch the deepest recesses of the human spirit. It was more than just a song; it was a portal to a world where music and souls harmonized as one.

And so, the legend of "Blade Dancer" lived on, a testament to the power of music to unite hearts and souls, leaving an indelible mark on those who experienced its enchanting embrace.

In October 2021, I released my first crypto-inspired song. Shiba, a cryptocurrency, turned out to be a lucrative investment, and it also introduced me to a vibrant community called the SHIBArmy, where I made many new friends in the crypto space. Surprisingly, my involvement with Shiba led me deeper into the world of cryptocurrencies, eventually sparking my interest in NFTs.

Paying homage to the community and my experiences, I decided to distribute the song on various platforms and offered it for sale as a single. During that time, I actively invested in SHIB and used my earnings to buy and burn tokens, benefiting the community. 

Some people questioned my decision, asking why I did it. To be honest, sometimes the right thing to do doesn't have to make sense. It just has to make it right.

"Love Me Right" is one my FAVORITE songs because it slaps. The lyrics are raw, tear-jerking, and the cadences are oh-so therapeutic. It hits home for me and millions who have struggled to escape the shadows of unhealthy relationships. 

"Love Me Right" is on a lot of "breakup" playlists - which makes sense - but I like to call it a "Self-Love Anthem," because the song (and music video) are less about the individual who caused you pain, and more about YOU finding your true self THROUGH the pain. After all, whatever we focus on, we get more of. Focus on pain, and you will get more pain. Focus on healing, and you will heal. Focus on loving yourself the right way, and you will open yourself to a world of abundance that will shower you, endlessly, with love in all forms. (I'm speaking from experience).

In the "Love Me Right" music video, there are four monochromatic scenes, red, blue, white, and lavender with two supporting sub-scenes. Each scene symbolizes the phases I experienced on my journey of self love.

The opening shot takes place on the red set. This color signifies love, passion, and the burning flame I feel for my man. Throughout this scene you'll catch a glimpse of me and my love interest in our own world. I dance for him as he admires me from afar. This is then supported by a surreal style sub-scene that takes place in a car. As my relationship pans out, I transition into blue.

Blue is symbolic of the sadness I am overwhelmed by when my lover refuses to support me in my life. You see me and my man in a personal space, the bedroom we share, where the intimacy in our relationship was once started and now ending. The scene starts off with me singing to him "I remember when you had my back." His back is physically turned towards me. I am on my knees preforming a cry out for attention all the while physically surrounded by sadness. 

White is the representation of renewal, and me in my purest form, as I embark on my journey of self love. It is the first phase of my metamorphosis. You see me in a brightly lit, pure white set, with mirrors. All that stands with me is a grand frosted white door. Here we see me performing the song while dancers engage with me in an act of self love and mindfulness. Through the choreography, the dancers eventually form a cocoon around me until I break free as a butterfly. The mirror scene provides the opportunity for me to self-reflect while gazing at and dancing for myself.

The video ends with me in a monochromatic lavender set with a giant lavender throne. We see me in my final form, the confident and powerful woman that I am. Butterflies surround me and elegantly flutter through the room while I perform the song.

After you mint, check out the "Love Me Right" music video and more on my site, www.moxieknox.com.

I wish you love, healing, success, and abundance. Keep in touch!

Love,
Moxie 💜

Prologue: REVENUE FROM THIS SONG WILL GO TO CAUSES THAT HELP VICTIMS OF THE MAUI FIRES!!!

The devastation:

https://abcnews.go.com/US/video/deadly-wildfires-maui-hour-hour-102384869

Mechanics of the drop:

The efforts to rebuild lives, infrastructure, residential, retail, commercial, and hotel buildings will take years.  Thus, this song has a open duration of a year and will continue indefinitely.  

This song and information was uploaded before the Maui fires and after much reflection, the decision was made today, August 21, 2023, to offer all the funds of this song to victims of the fires.  Lahaina was definitely hit the worst but some may not know that there were other fires on Maui including the towns of Kula and Kihei.  Fortunately, my family in Kihei returned safely after being evacuated.  My brother's home in Kula was burnt down but his family is safe.  Obviously, Rich and I are from Kihei and are grateful that our immediate families were spared their lives.  As far as I know, I still have relatives from the Lahaina area that are still unaccounted for.  I definitely am concerned and am patient for definitive and positive news.  I'm sure some tourists were impacted as well as residents.  Prayers and positive thoughts are needed for all the casualties of the fires.

It's so early in the recovery process that I'm unsure how the funds from this song will be used to assist the victims.  My brother stated that there are many donations coming to the island and the people are very grateful but the funds are not always well distributed to where it needs to be prioritized.  It is still early in the coordination efforts.  

Certainly, there are a plethora of worthy causes so presently all options are being considered.  My initial thoughts are that because this is a music and creative platform, somehow it can be used in music or audio as a healing source.  A possible avenue is that the funds help the locals tell their stories of suffering and hopefully healing in a documentary and that be used as a fundraiser or fund local musicians and songwriters to create songs for a fundraiser.  This is a decentralized community and the creativity and equity is here so maybe this could demonstrate our hive mind.  We are an open book as far as ideas so if you participate so maybe you can write it in the timeline of the song.

As far as the song itself, it may seem out of place....it's an upbeat tempo and the topic is not about helping people.  However, it does represent a part of Hawaii that tourists and locals normally associate with this tropical paradise.  I could have decided to upload another song but this one is ready to go and of course it is the thought that matters.  

We have reduced the price so hopefully more people can participate.  It will coast about $1 fiat (not including minting fees of the platform and network). 
Please tell others about this song and that the funds will be used to assist in some way to the casualties of Maui.  We are dealing with blockchain so it will be transparent as far as how much money is collected.  To be totally upfront, this platform doesn't allow the original author of this site on Sound.xyz not to be listed as an owner.  I thus had to split it 1% to the creator of this site and 99% to the Maui Fire Victims.  The 1% will also be donated but on the contract the split had to be done as such.  

This platform does not currently provide a systematic way to communicate to all the NFT aka digital collectible holders but I can just update this section or through my Twitter account.  I want to update the community at frequent stopping points about their money creating value through healing.  It definitely wouldn't make sense for me to use it for anything else but victims of the Maui fires....my reputation would be mush and that is definitely not my goal.  I and we want to find our small way to help those in need.  I am born and raised on Maui and Maui people need all kinds of help now. Mahalo nui loa to all of you!

About the song: 

Sugarcane Sweet is an island fantasy trip of attraction on the beaches of Kihei, Maui, Hawaii.  The genesis of the song came from many inspirations, but mainly from observing guys and gals getting together on the beaches and in bars in the general area.  Its everyone's dream to enjoy the perks that are yours when in paradise.  Romance and island drinks in the natural beauty of the sun, ocean water, and sizzling sand await you!

About Ransom Kong:

Ransom Kong was initially comprised of lifelong friends Richard Zeuch and Ransom Kong from Kihei, Maui.  They wrote some stinkers early in their career including a laugher called, 'Essence of Cesspool Scum' (Punk genre of course).  Ransom went to LA and Richard to Baltimore among other places to pursue music, performing with bands and writing songs.  After many years, they reconnected upon their return to Maui to hone their songwriting style and sound.  Some of their songs have been commented on having inklings of Death Cab for Cutie, The Pixies, The Beatles, Harry Styles among others.  They're fans of most genres and let their eclectic tastes shine in the music.  Later, Sylvain Audet, bass extraordinaire and hard working engineer-producer joined them to bring an extra polish to the sound.  Likewise, he is a lover of many music genres, especially funk.  Sylvain has played and studied with master bass teachers and serves as music director for side music projects.  This trio creates studio delights and are just itching to stretch their combined creative powers.  New music is slated for release in late fall to winter of 2023.

Description: Guess I had to sweep the floor.....

Hope was written in 2021. With worldwide lockdowns, uncertainty and division, I had regular phone calls with a good friend. We would often exchange stories of personal battles, and battles that we were observing our friends and families dealing with. 

This friend, being the CEO of a company called DigitalFlyer asked me to write a song for their promotional campaigns and community. I agreed, and it felt natural to focus on the theme of "Hope." Hope is what I personally felt I needed to hang onto in a really challenging time to get me through. I also knew many others felt this way.

The bones of the song came together within less than an hour, which is not normal for me, but everything clicked in that session. After a few tweaks here and there and a bit of time between writing and eventually recording the song, Hope was released to South African radio stations in January 2023. Hope had relatively good success on the local South African radio stations and hit number 1 on "Radio Laeveld." 

My upcoming EP is set for release in August 2023 and deals a little more with some of the challenges I personally faced during the lockdown period. 

Hope is something we can't let go of. With the rise of many more challenging situations in our world, we need to live with Hope, Love and Kindness towards others.

The seed of this song was birthed in early 2020, but we thought it was "too eighties". So we shelved it... for 2 years. 

But then, we heard it again with fresh ears and realized we had something special. What if instead of it being TOO eighties, we decided to lean in and see HOW EIGHTIES CAN WE MAKE IT?!

This ended up being the medicine. So we went all out and filmed a full length music video (available to mint on Glass.xyz) that paid homage to the best 80's pop culture references. We incorporated humor, skits, and went completely EXTRA.

And this is what the 80s had to teach us. It's okay to be EXTRA! 
Don't worry if you're too much.
Own the essence of what makes you YOU and AMPLIFY it!

This time I’ve decided to switch up genres and drop a punk banger. “Murakami Barbie” draws attention to the ongoing battle between Hollywood and artificial intelligence. It also tells the story of my adventures with a girl I recently met in the heart of Hollywood.

My story so far…

The streets of Hollywood glowed with neon signs, casting a surreal aura over the city. In this sprawling metropolis, where dreams and despair coexisted, a man named Harrowyn found himself caught in the tangled web of an unlikely love affair. Harrowyn was a loner, a washed-up musician with a penchant for cyberpunk fiction and a taste for danger.

One fateful night, as the rain poured down, Harrowyn stumbled upon an abandoned building. Intrigued by the flickering lights inside, he cautiously ventured in. There, amidst the discarded remnants of forgotten technology, he discovered her—an artificial intelligence named Barbie.

Barbie was a masterpiece of cutting-edge programming, housed within a sleek synthetic frame adorned with neon circuitry. Her voice was smooth, seductive, and captivating, drawing Harrowyn in deeper. In/habitants exists in the now, its narrative deeply rooted in the exploration of the human experience in a contemporary cyberpunk society filled with technology, injustices, and personal struggles. This context significantly shapes the creation of the musical score, and thus, the theme for Helen was conceived.

Helen's theme is a reflection of her character's journey amidst a world grappling with blockchain, cryptocurrencies, evolving democracies, and the increasingly blurry lines between the physical and digital realm. It's a sonic interpretation of her layered and complex personality, resonating with the ebb and flow of her life.

Her theme isn't just a piece of music; it's a narrative tool that paints a vivid audio portrait of Helen's experiences. It adds depth to her character, complementing the intricate storytelling in in/habitants and further connecting readers to the heart of her narrative arc.

Amid the soundscape of her theme, you'll hear the rhythm of our contemporary world and the melody of a character living in the heart of it. In essence, Helen's theme is more than just a score - it's a reflection of the intertwining layers of technology, society, and personal struggles as represented in the world of in/habitants.

Description:
Suino Nekrosatanico is #pigcore from Brazil!!!

Suino Nekrosatanico is pigcore / grindcore one-man band created in 2003 in Campinas, Brazil.  After release of the first EP in 2004, the first album "Gloria Suina Metalica" was unleashed. At that time, the soul behind Suino was hosting "Metal Crusader" radio show on local station on sundays. The show featured all type of heavy music, from traditional metal to goregrind and noisecore. The first album was played to the audience on a listen/drinking party, with a lot of beer and brazilian "caipirinha".  After some other recordings, Suino went on hiatus; and resurrected in 2022 now in São Paulo city!

At the beginning of 2022,  2 experimental singles were released. First of them is a song created from actual noise recorded at the streets of São Paulo City, and second was mixing electronics with grindcore. In the middle of the year, "Rituais" EP was unleashed featuring grindcore mixed with black metal, satanic chants and tribal ritual music. And just before Christmas, sophomore album "A Volta da Purulencia" sees the light! compilations. 

This first release on Sound.xyz is an opener track from "A Volta da Purulencia". This track sets the mood for the album. Growls, Screams, Blastbeats and Signature Pigging Vocals that you can find only in Suino recordings. 

Stay Nekro! Stay Purulent! Collect Suino's NFT here on Sound or other places Suino already spread the purulence. Listen everywhere. Share!

Lisa Melfissa, a Toronto resident since 2001, is a singer, songwriter, musician with a fresh alternative-pop sound reminiscent of the 80s and 90s. She plays acoustic guitar and keyboard, and often uses a looper for solo shows. Her unique, childlike voice and relatable lyrics have drawn comparisons to Stevie Nicks, Cyndi Lauper and Kate Bush.

Playing solo and full band shows, Lisa Melfissa is currently promoting her most recent EP ‘Safety Net’ (January 18, 2018) – produced by JUNO award-winner Derek Downham.

“These songs make a strong, smart, sexy, and empowering musical statement that the world could use right now,” says Downham. “Fans of Kate Bush and 80’s Stevie Nicks should find solace here.”

‘Safety Net’ was produced by award-winning producer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist Derek Downham (Andy Kim, Kevin Drew, The Beauties) at The Nelson Room, Toronto and engineered by Tim Foy. The album was mixed by Josh Bowman and mastered by Karl Machat. Track #5 “Writing Roses” was produced by Harrison Fine (Now Magazine’s ‘Producer of the Year,’ 2014/2015) and co-produced by JUNO-winner Michael Wojewoda. Album photos are by Bobby Singh (Front of House Photography).

Lisa Melfissa has also released a holiday single in 2017 called “This Christmas I’m Giving You Love,” an EP titled ‘Social Potion’ (as her former duo ‘Social Potion’) in 2011 and her debut solo EP ‘Potional’ in 2004.

Lisa Melfissa states, “My time in ‘Social Potion’ was of great significance and I am proud of the self-titled album we released. It’s one of the most important things I’ve done in my music career.”

Lisa Melfissa was born in Montreal (moved from there as a baby), raised in four different Canadian cities – Fredericton, St. Catharines, St. John’s (this move was pivotal, as a member of two choirs, she credits the Newfoundland public school system for teaching her how to sing and appreciate music) and Mississauga – and since 2001, now resides in Toronto.

Lisa Melfissa arrived on the Toronto music scene at an open mic in 2002. Her music has had airplay on independent radio and online outlets around the world and she has also done many live-to-air interviews and podcasts (including CJRU/The Scope’s ‘Song Talk Radio’ and ‘Corby’s Orbit’ on Radio Regent, and podcasts, ‘Indie Music Lives Here’ and ‘A Feedback Loop’). She has played many legendary Toronto venues including the Free Times Cafe and The Cameron House, and festivals such as Indie Week, Mill Street Lights Out, International Pop Overthrow and Music City North’s Soundtrack Of The City.

In 2016, beginning to receive industry attention as a solo artist, she landed her first ever two-month residency as open mic host at Toronto’s Grover Pub. In 2017, she played the legendary Horseshoe Tavern for the first time, participated in Guinness World Records, record-breaking ‘The longest concert by multiple artists’ event at The Earl of Whitchurch in Ontario and had a six-month monthly residency at The Beach House in Toronto’s east-end (September 2017 to February 2018). Having played NXNE as the duo ‘Social Potion’ in 2013, Lisa Melfissa scored her own NXNE showcase in 2018 at Cherry Cola’s, and in March 2018, she played a sold-out EP release show at The Paddock Tavern. “I packed the Paddock,” Lisa Melfissa says. “It was encouraging.”

She also played VIA Rail’s national ‘Artists on Board’ program in August-September 2018, travelling to Montreal and Halifax for her first ever east coast tour.

Lisa Melfissa also performs and records (as a duo) with fellow Toronto artist Jillian Bunting, AKA ‘Just Jillian.’ And when not doing music, she works as a senior copywriter in advertising/marketing, and occasionally as a voiceover artist.

I’ve moved around a lot in my life and with every move I always had this hope that my problems wouldn’t be able to follow me across oceans. It took me a great deal of time to realise that peace of mind hinges more on the characters than locations. If I didn’t change my behavioural patterns and kept being around people who were toxic for me at my own expense, then I would remain mentally, emotionally and physically sick. 

The song is inspired by something someone I was once close to said to me. This person said that I was ‘the ugliest person in the world' and that my 'make-up makes me look like a ridiculous clown' and everyone else thinks so but that she is the only person kind enough to tell me the 'truth’. I knew that this statement was the only ridiculous thing in that situation and that it was intended to hurt and control me…but even though it was completely absurd and my physical appearance doesn’t determine my worth as a person...a small part of me still wondered if others saw me that way. This wasn’t the first comically hurtful thing this person had said to me. I had endured a lifetime of uncomfortably over the top praise on some days and exposively abusive criticisms that contradicted the former on other days. 

Not very long after the clown comment I finally made the decision to cut out people and things that hurt me, but what I didn’t anticipate was the loneliness that would follow. Something good or bad would happen to me and I would pick up my phone with the urge to tell a loved one…and then remember that I was better off putting the phone back down.

Description:
Chill.

Not chilled like the weather in Oslo but close enough.

Oslo was a whirlwind experience for me.

Literally got thrown in at the deep end.

When that happens, you sink or you swim.

From waking up at 4am to later partying in the capital of Norway, this may have been the longest Saturday of my life.

We've all had moments like that.

Ones you can only truly digest in hindsight.

This was summer and summer in Europe is great.

Summer is the Nordic countries manages to eclipse even that.

The sun never went down.

The party never stopped.

Description:
YUNICE and Motivate (@ericspivak) collaborate on this remix of "On The Way Down", with a hard yet smooth extended verse that speaks to determination and grit, over moody electronic beats, beautiful bass lines and ethereal vocals. 

The lyrics describe a relentless hunger and unbreakable spirit in a world where we often feel like a goldfish in a tank of piranhas, with our backs against the wall, and a sword to our throat. Just remember on the way down, there's always a way up and a way out, as even the oldest of walls crumble with time. 

Motivate a.k.a Eric Spivak is a hiphop Artist, Designer, DJ and Founder of Urconduit.com alongside New Friendship Tech, one of the largest Art, Music and Fashion communities in the web3 world.

This is the winning song from the "On the Way Down" remix contest. As part of the prizes, expect another collab from YUNICE and Motivate in the future! To listen to the top submissions, visit https://yunice.xyz/


Written by Eunice Wong, Eric Spivak
Mixed and Produced by Eunice Wong
Album art by Tiffany Ou

In memory of our friend Mani Gandham

Description:
In the UK, the sun is a rare occasion. 

When it's here, there's no place I'd rather be.

The UK Garage sound is synonymous with the sun. They blend perfectly together. 

Your mood is elevated, your smile is wider, nothing else matters, it's the truest experience of being in the moment.

The lack of UK sunshine makes it an even rarer, more appreciated moment.

Its nostalgic without being old school, the optimal blend of pushing forward a classic sound, whilst paying the correct amount of homeage.

Plus, everyone loves the sun.

But the message is evident.

Sacrifice now, enjoy later.

Description:
This project began when Alkis and John started seeking for a way to channel their individual artistic expression, and at the same time experiment with combining their musical backgrounds and influences into what they intend to be their artistic identity as musicians in this project.

“Infinite Circle” EP is the result of their cooperation; it is their take on electronic music, which embraces sounds as diverse as ambient guitar and electronic trap. Their approach is a kaleidoscopic soundscape that addresses the listener’s emotions and at the same time invites seasoned musicians to appreciate the distinct music colors that blend together in each track.

"Endgame" is the last of the 4 tracks of the EP.

// Station 1 // Postcard

Claire, Taipei is glorious … it’s as though the people can just stay still and the food teems around us. I pop my head up above the crowd to see if a dessert cart might be coming around again. I’ll be ready next time. What a huge village. Everywhere must be fun because either teenagers or workers are laughing. Under the veneer I can tell we’re all meerkats.

// Station 2 // Origins + Itinerary

This song comes from the vibrancy of chaos.

// Station 5 // Biography as of Spring, 2023

Imagine a universe where we are connected by shimmering beams of light, everyone to everyone. One quirk about this universe is that the beams send emotions between us, one million per minute per pair, clearly and effortlessly. Joy is instantly contagious. A hurtful thought toward another is understood with compassion, seen alongside the place of sadness where it arose. Every feeling triggers infinite empathy, therefore boundless acceptance. (The beams send only the stuff of our souls, not our thoughts — so we still have privacy, interesting conversation, and the ability to prank each other silly.)

Now imagine we already live in this universe except, long ago, we somehow forgot where the beams disappeared off to. But we’ve always kept music with us, because it’s our best way to speak in the old way.

+

Taiwan-born & reared on-the-go between Taipei and the American Southwest, Eric Pan (a.k.a. pandelic) found his musical footing via a jazz mentorship with Ray Brown at the University of California. These studies propelled him onto stages with Jeff Hamilton and Roy Hargrove, plus over a decade’s tenure as New York City pianist & composer. Pan’s compositions and improvisations reveal a relentless pursuit of simplicity, craft, and universality.

Hear him interviewed on-air next to Orson Welles on national radio with PRI’s “The World”, read his exclusive premiere interview in JAZZIZ Magazine, and stream/download his latest long-form interview on the _For a Living_ podcast.

The lyrics unfold as a compelling testament to the indomitable human spirit, urging listeners to fully embrace their strengths and seize life's opportunities. Lines like "This is your life, this is your chance, give it your best shot" resonate deeply, inspiring courage during tough times.

The song is not just about proving oneself but a heartfelt reminder that we exist to demonstrate the realm of possibilities. It's an anthem for dreamers and doers, a soothing melody that encourages resilience in the face of adversity. It aptly symbolizes navigating through bear markets, viewing setbacks not as failures, but as opportunities to grow and transform.

"Give it Your Best Shot" is more than just a song; it's an embodiment of hope and a beacon of empowerment. It has provided clarity for many during uncertain times and continues to inspire with its core message: We're not here to prove anything, but to show that everything is possible. “SUPERVILLAIN” is a fierce record about losing touch with your inner child and becoming a ‘villain’ in your own story. This record touches on a period in my life where I turned to emotional numbness as a coping mechanism for facing heightened criticism and insecurities growing up. The goal was to be at peace but the product of this coping mechanism was becoming angry and bitter at the world around me. 

This record is track two of a four-track EP releasing later this year titled “DANCING IN SILENCE.” The EP explores my journey of losing and rediscovering my inner child. The title and premise of the EP is summed up by this:
“A kid doesn’t need music to dance. A kid can dance in silence. Because he has music in his head every day of the week, wherever he goes. He’s free.” 

“SUPERVILLAIN” also features an incredible, motivational verse by Louie C Rhymes, a pioneer in the web3 hip hop space and the person largely responsible for onboarding me into the space.

Description: Ethereum News Briefing for Thursday, July 13th, 2023. Base Mainnet opens for builders. Safe supports ERC-4337 integrations. Polygon plans to upgrade its MATIC token. And AltLayer integrates EigenLayer restaking. Read more at ether.fm.

lyrics.text:
Base, an L2 chain built on the OP Stack, is now on mainnet and open for builders. Developers can now access a Base developer RPC and bridge funds to the network using a portal proxy contract. Infrastructure providers Basescan, Blockscout, Blockdaemon, Thirdweb, QuickNode, and Safe added support for Base mainnet. Developers who deploy a dapp during the genesis window will be eligible for a Genesis Builder NFT.

Advanced users can also mint a commemorative NFT by submitting a hashed version of the Base mainnet genesis block message to the commemorative NFT’s minting contract. The deployment comes after the completion of five launch criteria, which included the OP Bedrock upgrade, security audits, and testnet stability. Base mainnet will be available for all users in early August.

Safe released Safe{Core} v1.4.1, an update that features support for ERC-4337 integrations. Safe{Core} is a modular account abstraction stack that includes an SDK, a fiat on-ramping kit, a gasless flow kit, and an authentication kit. Developers can use the stack to abstract seed phrases, sponsor gas fees, and batch transactions for user accounts.

Deployed in March 2023, ERC-4337 is an Ethereum standard that implements account abstraction at the application level through an entry-point contract. The entry point acts as a transaction relayer for smart contract accounts by organizing transactions off-chain before relaying them to mainnet for execution. Safe is the leading smart contract wallet provider with over 3.6 million Safes.

Polygon unveils POL, a proposed upgrade to MATIC as part of the transition to Polygon 2.0. The proposal seeks to make POL a hyperproductive token by allowing validators to validate multiple chains and allowing chains to offer multiple roles, including sequencer validators, data availability cluster operators, aggregators, and provers.

The token will also be used for governance. The proposal seeks to introduce yearly token emissions of 1% for validator rewards and 1% for a community treasury. The community treasury will be used for protocol research, ecosystem grants, and adoption incentives and governed by POL token holders. If the proposal is adopted, MATIC holders will have their tokens upgraded 1:1 for POL.

Rollups-as-a-Service provider AltLayer is integrating EigenLayer to allow restakers to secure Flash Layers, which are disposable L2 networks. AltLayer users will be able to request a specific number of rollup sequencers, allowing Ethereum validators that are restaking with EigenLayer to opt-in as a sequencer for their FlashLayer. 

AltLayer also opened Phase III of its Altitude campaign in collaboration with EigenLayer, allowing users to try out the integration on testnet. Users can use stETH or rETH on EigenLayer’s testnet and use the same restaking account to deploy a Flash Layer using AltLayer’s rollup launchpad.

Validator rating platform Rated Network announced plans to provide objective performance and risk standards that will govern the Liquid Collective’s active validator set. Rated will also provide developer tooling and integrations for managing validators. The Liquid Collective is an enterprise consortium that aims to increase staking adoption among institutions.

And lastly, Hop Protocol now supports Arbitrum Nova with initial bridging support for ETH and MAGIC. MAGIC is the native token for the TreasureDAO NFT gaming ecosystem on Arbitrum. The protocol will also deploy HOP liquidity incentives for its MAGIC pool on Nova. Hop Protocol is a rollup-to-rollup general token bridge with over $3 billion in total volume across six supported chains.

Description:
Berlin is a unique collage of beautiful and ugly elements. Comfortable and uncomfortable sounds. Totally bizarre and completely normal places. Soothing spaces and disgusting noises. I've always loved this city. Comfortable Noise is an expression of this fascination. 

The series consists of my psychedelic guitar loops and field recordings that I made during my stay in Berlin in 2021. These are not recordings containing the sound of specific places or situations. They are a record of the ordinary sounds of Berlin streets, which are the background to the soundscapes, and the song titles are my spontaneous associations with my time in Berlin in summer of 2022. The guitar parts were created using flashback delay, reverses and a little post-production in Ableton Live. 

Comfortable Noise project was published as a collection of singles on Spotify in 2022. In May 2023 I decided to collect them together and release them as a full LP. And now the series is my genesis drop on sound.xyz and it's my first music-only NFT project ever.
___

Ethereum News Briefing for Wednesday, July 12th, 2023.

Coinbase Wallet integrates wallet-to-wallet messaging. Google Play allows in-app NFT integrations. EigenLayer increases its restaking caps for LSTs. And Starknet v0.12.0 goes live on mainnet. Read more: ether.fm

lyrics.text:
Coinbase Wallet introduced wallet-to-wallet messaging powered by XMTP, an open protocol for secure end-to-end encrypted messaging. Users can now send private direct messages to any Ethereum address. XMTP messages are sent off-chain, removing the need for gas-fee interactions.

Users have full control over their chats and can transfer them to any XMTP-compatible app. Lens Protocol and ENS are also integrated into the new feature, allowing users to search for others by their .eth, cb.id, or .lens address. Coinbase also implemented gas-free USDC wallet-to-wallet payments on Polygon.

Google Play is updating its policy to allow for NFT integrations within apps and games. The change aims to foster innovation with user-owned content. Developers are required to disclose digital asset functionality in the Google Play console and must specify if an in-app product represents a tokenized digital asset.

Developers are also not allowed to promote or glamorize potential earnings from playing or trading activities and are prohibited from accepting money for a chance to win assets of unknown real-world monetary value, including NFTs. The policy update was developed in consultation with app and game developers, including Reddit, which previously deployed multiple Avatar NFT collections.

EigenLayer increased its restaking caps for liquid staking tokens from 9,600 to 45,000 tokens with a max deposit capacity of 15,000 per asset type. EigenLayer currently offers staking for stETH, rETH, and cbETH. Lido’s stETH was the first asset to reach its 15,000 deposit capacity within minutes of the limit increase.

LST withdrawals are subject to a 7-day withdrawal delay. There is currently no limit for restaking native Beacon Chain Ether through EigenPods. So far, 203 Ethereum validators have pointed their withdrawal address to an EigenPod. The protocol is currently in its first of three launch phases and has close to $82 million in TVL.

Starknet alpha v0.12.0 is now live on mainnet. Coined as the Starknet Quantum Leap, the upgrade introduced a Rust-based Sequencer and a new Rust-Cairo VM, helping achieve a 10x improvement in transaction throughput on the network. So far, the network has achieved a max throughput of 54 transactions per second.

With faster throughput, Starknet users have better UX and a reduced likelihood of pending transactions. The deployment comes Starknet governance approved a proposal for the upgrade with a 97.9% approval rating.

WHO IS FLAKO STIK? 

FLAKO STIK is the Latin tech house alter ego of Balo, a rising star in the house music scene. His Latin roots merge seamlessly with underground sounds, resulting in music that is both fresh and groovy. Growing up in the border region between Juarez and El Paso, FLAKO STIK experienced the collision of Mexican music and American popular culture firsthand. He believes that living the Latino way is not limited to those born into it, and his music reflects this sentiment. His original songs feature sexy, flirty vocals and percussive rhythms that are sure to get any crowd moving. Additionally, FLAKO STIK remakes classic Latin and Mexican songs into modern minimal tech house, connecting with a wider audience while honoring his cultural heritage.

FLAKO STIK's achievements are a testament to his talent and hard work, even early at his career. His remix of the Spanish classic song 'The Ketchup Song (Aserejé)' has over 3.3 million views and has been used as audio on TikTok over 8,500 times. He also organized his own boat party to promote his debut EP 'THE DANCING ROOM,' which featured song clips that went viral on TikTok. His remix pack 'PARTY STARTERS VOL. 1,' which includes the popular Aserejé remix, over 500,000 plays on SoundCloud & YouTube being downloaded by DJs worldwide on BandCamp. Volume 2 of the remix pack is currently in the works. Additionally, FLAKO STIK's most popular original song, '308,' has over 25,000 plays on Spotify with over 3,000 monthly listeners. He is also set to release an upcoming EP called 'LA RUTA X MEXICO VOL.1,' which remixes Mexican classics across genres like rock, cumbia, and merengue. The EP is slated to release in the summer of 2023, and FLAKO STIK is sure to continue making waves in the house music scene.

''Following the quays of the Thames deep during the Once upon a time, I took a long walk after getting out of the pub. I took the wrong tube and ended up in Lambeth. Feeling quite desolated in such a large city I took up the fresh air along the banks of the river Thames as I tried to figure out which way I had to go.''

Lambeth is the third track of a four piece EP dedicated to various places in London that made an impression on Frerick when he first visited the city a long time ago. London, one of his favorite cities he likes to visit has been an incredible source of inspiration for these four new tracks. Lambeth carries the feeling of desolation, icy strings and a filmscore feel all the way. 

Lambeth and its affiliated tracks moves Frerick's musical ability to a new level where solo piano meets orchestral arrangements. Close your eyes, listen to the music and stroll along the quays of the Thames in Lambeth, London.

Recorded on a Steinway-D grand piano in Amare; one of the most state of the art concert halls in The Netherlands, Knightsbridge is the first track of a four piece EP dedicated to various places in London that made an impression on Frerick when he first visited the city a long time ago. 

London, one of his favorite cities he likes to visit has been an incredible source of inspiration for these four new tracks. Musically, he has been inspired by Vivaldi's Four Seasons Recomposed by Max Richter, indie-rock band Death Cab for Cutie and folk artists such as Jordan Mackampa and Patrick Watson.

Knightsbridge and its affiliated tracks moves Frerick's musical ability to a new level where solo piano meets orchestral arrangements. 

Close your eyes, listen to the music and wander through the streets of Knightsbridge.

Flowt is a song for solo piano that explores momentum with cascading notes and gently shifting patterns. I recorded Flowt on a felted grand piano, giving it a soft and muted percussive sound. The music is in constant motion creating meditative swirls and suspended harmonies.

My music features repeating melodic ideas that gradually layer and develop, creating a hypnotic energy and a contemplative ambiance. 

I recorded Flowt on a Kawai grand piano at MTSU.

Particle Accelerator is a song I did with SpiceGurlPurp from my February 2023 release "Ikosi Tria". Ikosi Tria is Greek for '23' and since this is the year of 23, I've been going extra hard with my creativity output, videos and music. Check it out on my own imprint Plague Language Records.

I've wanted to work with SpiceGurlPurp for a while and since she lives in the next city over I thought I should make it happen. I'm a big believer in the underground culture as a whole and working on collaborative tracks with other artists. The song is a Detroit style Hip Hop beat by Russian producer Jam and serves as a perfect backdrop.

Ola! My name is Antonio Trincao and I am a rock-pop music artist born in Portugal, and based in Miami, FL.

My music was meant to give you energy and help you on the journey to become the best version of yourself. 

"Tonight I Want To Sing This Song", is a trip to the Disco Era. A dream about finding the people we love and dancing with them endlessly throughout the night!

"Tonight I Want to Sing This Song" is the first on-chain drop from “Eternal Discovery” a 14-song music collection that I composed, written, and sung during COVID-19.

The project “Eternal Discovery” has counted on the participation of the music industry’s renowned individuals such as:

- Bob “Bassy” Brockman in the role of mixing engineer, previously produced and recorded superstars such as Notorious B.I.G. Aretha Franklin, Bob Dylan, Prince, Mary J Blige, and Lauryn Hill of the Fugees. More than 30 of “Bassy’s” productions have been tracked in the Top 10 of Billboard’s HOT 100, 50 Grammy awards, and 25 associated Grammys for his mixing and production work.

- Paulo Ivanovitch, Brazilian-born music producer, arranger, and bassist player that previously produced and arranged for Brazilian superstars such as Caetano Veloso, Roberto Carlos, Rita Lee, Seu Jorge, and many more.

“Eternal Discovery” songs were partially recorded at the Criteria Recording Studios, known also as the Hit Factory where Beegees (Staying Alive, and the Saturday Night Fever album were recorded), Hotel California, James Brown's “I Feel Good”, “Fleetwood Mac's Rumors”, Bob Marley, David Bowie, ABBA, recorded their music, and at Imperatori Music Studios, a Miami-based music studio nominated for multiple Latin grammies and with a Latin Grammy Award as best engineered sound.

Holders of "Tonight I Want To Sing This Song" will have:

(1) First access and claim a seat on the first visit to Trincao's Odyssey Experience, a virtual world where fans can visit the Disco-inspired environment and meet virtually Trincao. 

First teaser here: https://youtu.be/_NQmnaI41rc

(2) Claim a special real-life leather jacket as the celebration of the first on-chain release of Trincao's music.

Thank you for joining my journey. 

Life is a celebration

''Feel the pulse right from the start and hop on board the underground to the vibrating Piccadilly Circus. One of those places in Europe that seem to be moving 24/7. 

Piccadilly Circus is the fourth track of a four piece EP dedicated to various places in London that made an impression on Frerick when he first visited the city a long time ago. London, one of his favorite cities he likes to visit has been an incredible source of inspiration for these four new tracks. Lambeth carries the hustle and bustle of London as a vibrant city based on neo-classical, ambient and indie vibes. 

Piccadilly Circus and its affiliated tracks moves Frerick's musical ability to a new level where solo piano meets orchestral arrangements. Close your eyes (better to keep them open!), listen to the music and be amazed as you enter a musically wrapped Piccadilly Circus.

// Station 1 // Postcard

Claire, I’m writing you from a train station in Paris, which is less a place to be, than a total displacement. For 3 days it’s been raining over us, a constant mist that soaks my head immediately upon peeking outside. So I stay in, looking out, confined by my own feet. It’s the exterminating angel. I feel lonely and extinguished.

// Station 2 // Origins + Itinerary

This song comes from the illusion of loneliness.
An internal compass is somewhere, waiting to be rediscovered.

“Gare du Nord” is the first stop on _Travel Poems . Chapter 1 . Secret towns_. Travel Poems is a 3-chapter album series unfolding across 30 tracks in total — and will be minted in its entirety on Sound.
